title: Ontology Marketplace: Enabling Scalable Ontology Sharing for Semantic Interoperability
affiliations: Kansas State University, Kansas State University, Johnson & Johnson, Neo4J and Kansas State University

detail.title: Ontology Marketplace: Enabling Scalable Ontology Sharing for Semantic Interoperability
detail.abstract: The increasing adoption of semantic web technologies and the rapid proliferation of knowledge graph-driven tools underscore the urgent need for a robust, scalable infrastructure to manage ontology change requests, foster community feedback, and support both developers and users with advanced tooling. There is a growing demand for a platform that not only facilitates these processes but also accelerates community engagement and practical use of ontologies and knowledge graphs through AI-ready technologies such as Neo4j. To address this gap, we present the Ontology Marketplace, a community-driven, event-aware platform designed to streamline the submission, tracking, moderation, and implementation of ontology-related requests. By establishing seamless communication channels among users, tools, and curators, this platform aims to reduce the turnaround time for ontology updates from months to minutes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个名为Ontology Marketplace的社区驱动、事件感知平台，旨在通过简化本体变更请求的提交、跟踪、审核和实施流程，将本体更新周期从数月缩短至数分钟。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个社区驱动的平台，以高效管理本体变更请求、促进社区反馈，并加速本体的实际应用？
AI.motivation: 语义网技术的普及和知识图谱工具的快速增长，使得对本体变更管理基础设施的需求日益迫切，而现有平台在社区参与度和更新效率方面存在明显不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本体工程、知识图谱、社区驱动开发和事件驱动架构。
AI.method: 平台设计与开发——提出了一个事件感知、社区驱动的本体市场平台，整合了请求提交、跟踪、审核和实施等功能。
AI.findings: 该平台能够建立用户、工具和策展人之间的无缝沟通渠道，将本体更新周期从数月缩短至数分钟。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了事件感知机制在本体变更管理中的应用框架，丰富了社区驱动本体工程的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个可落地的本体管理平台方案，能显著加速本体更新迭代，提升社区协作效率，支持AI就绪技术（如Neo4j）的集成应用。

title: Generative Brand Narrative Intelligence: A State-aware Multimodal Agent Framework for Autonomous Emotionally Adaptive Brand Communication

detail.title: Generative Brand Narrative Intelligence: A State-aware Multimodal Agent Framework for Autonomous Emotionally Adaptive Brand Communication

declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The work was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract:
Contemporary AI systems address brand communication along one of two axes: they either monitor public narratives about a brand (inbound narrative intelligence, as operationalized by platforms such as Pulsar and PeakMetrics) or they generate isolated content pieces on demand using generative AI tools. Neither axis supports a third, operationally critical capability: continuously generating, governing, publishing, and learning from brand narratives as a persistent autonomous service. This paper introduces Generative Brand Narrative Intelligence (G-BNI) to designate and formalize this missing capability, and presents the Emotionally Adaptive Brand Narrative (EABN) framework as its first concrete implementation. EABN is a multimodal multi-agent system orchestrated via LangGraph in which seven specialized autonomous agents coordinate across a state-aware narrative lifecycle, the paper's central architectural contribution. Every content artifact transitions explicitly through defined states (Planned, Generated, Pending, Approved, Published, Analyzed), transforming content from an ephemeral output into a managed operational entity. An Emotional Adaptation Engine (EAE) governs narrative tone through structured rotation across eight emotional registers (Ambition, Transformation, Confidence, Future Success, Belonging, Innovation, Leadership, Independence), while a layered Emotional Anti-Repetition Mechanism enforces sustained diversity through phrase filtering, structural variation, and cliche detection. A Controllable Autonomy governance interface preserves human editorial judgment through selective component regeneration without disrupting pipeline continuity. G-BNI is formally defined with five testable qualifying properties and evaluated against existing system categories including inbound NI platforms, generative AI tools, social schedulers, multi-agent frameworks, and marketing automation systems. The EABN framework is the only system satisfying all five properties simultaneously. 

We contribute a formal G-BNI theoretical construct, a replicable seven-agent architecture, a structured evaluation framework with twelve metrics mapped to five research questions, and a research agenda for autonomous AI-native brand communication systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了生成式品牌叙事智能（G-BNI）这一新概念，并设计了情感自适应品牌叙事（EABN）框架作为其实现。EABN是一个基于LangGraph的多模态多智能体系统，通过七个自治智能体在状态感知叙事生命周期中协同工作，并引入情感适应引擎和可控自治治理接口，实现了品牌叙事的持续生成、治理、发布与学习，超越了现有AI系统仅监测或单次生成的能力。
AI.research_question: 如何设计和形式化一种能够持续、自治地生成、治理、发布和学习品牌叙事的AI系统能力，以弥补现有AI系统（监测型或单次生成型）在品牌传播中的关键缺口？
AI.motivation: 现有AI品牌传播系统存在二元分裂：要么仅监测公众叙事（如Pulsar、PeakMetrics），要么仅用生成式AI工具按需生成孤立内容，缺乏将品牌叙事作为持续性自治服务来运营的第三种能力。这种能力缺口在商业实践中至关重要，但尚未被正式定义和实现。
AI.theoretical_framework: G-BNI理论建构（提出五个可测试的合格属性）、EABN框架（多智能体架构）、状态感知叙事生命周期（六阶段状态转换）、情感适应引擎（八种情感寄存器轮转）、分层情感抗重复机制（短语过滤、结构变异、陈词检测）、可控自治治理界面。
AI.method: 概念形式化与架构设计：定义G-BNI的五个可测试属性，构建基于LangGraph的七智能体多模态多智能体系统，设计十二个指标映射到五个研究问题的结构化评估框架，并与现有系统类别（入站NI平台、生成式AI工具、社交媒体调度器、多智能体框架、营销自动化系统）进行比较评估。
AI.findings: EABN框架是唯一同时满足G-BNI全部五个属性的系统。该框架通过七个自治智能体在状态感知生命周期（Planned→Generated→Pending→Approved→Published→Analyzed）中协同工作，将内容从瞬时输出转化为可管理的运营实体；情感适应引擎通过八种情感寄存器轮转和三层抗重复机制保持叙事多样性；可控自治界面允许人类选择性干预而不中断流水线。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出并形式化定义G-BNI概念及其五个可测试合格属性，为自主品牌叙事系统建立了理论基础；提出了状态感知叙事生命周期作为核心架构贡献；设计了结构化评估框架（十二个指标对应五个研究问题），为后续研究提供了可复用的评价标准。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了EABN框架这一可直接复制的七智能体架构实现；情感适应引擎和抗重复机制解决了品牌内容多样性和情感一致性的实际挑战；可控自治治理界面平衡了AI自动化与人类编辑判断，适用于真实商业环境中的品牌传播运营。

title: An OCR-free, Position-aware VLM Process for Semi-structured Business Document Structuring: Design, Evaluation, and Enterprise Deployment Evidence
affiliations: Korea University Business School and Korea University Business School

detail.title: An OCR-free, Position-aware VLM Process for Semi-structured Business Document Structuring: Design, Evaluation, and Enterprise Deployment Evidence
detail.abstract: Enterprises routinely process commercial invoices in which the same business field appears under different label strings, at different spatial positions, and within tables of differing column structure across issuing organizations. Optical character recognition (OCR) pipelines linearize content by reading order and require a separate alignment step that does not transfer across issuers. Key information extraction (KIE) systems address field assignment but degrade when layouts deviate from those seen during adaptation, and the benchmark datasets that anchor their progress adopt narrow schemas (four target fields on SROIE; form-element classification on FUNSD) that do not reproduce simultaneous extraction of a comprehensive business-field set. We design and evaluate an OCR-free pipeline that submits document images directly to a vision-language model, applies position-aware extraction prompts, structures output through a two-stage call sequence, and routes residual errors through a human-in-the-loop verification interface before enterprise export. On 1,000 annotated commercial invoices spanning eleven simultaneous business fields, the pipeline achieves a document-level exact match rate of 0.97 without supervised adaptation to invoice layouts. A tendocument comparative benchmark against six OCR services, three KIE systems, and eight alternative vision-language model configurations provides directional evidence on comparative performance and workflow burden.. Average processing time is 10 seconds and cost is $0.01 USD per document. A twelve-participant pilot indicates operational tractability for the consultant group tested. The contribution is a design-rationale-grounded pipeline operating across heterogeneous invoice layouts without per-issuer reconfiguration, together with a multi-dimensional evaluation framework jointly covering accuracy, processing time, cost, and operator usability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需OCR的发票信息提取流水线，直接使用视觉-语言模型处理文档图像，通过位置感知提示和两阶段调用结构，在跨组织、跨布局的1000张商业发票上实现了0.97的文档级精确匹配率，且无需针对发票布局进行监督适应。该方案同时评估了准确性、处理时间、成本和操作员可用性四个维度。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种无需OCR、无需针对不同发票发行方进行重新配置的流水线，实现跨异构商业发票布局的多个业务字段的同步关键信息提取？
AI.motivation: 现有OCR流水线需要对齐步骤且无法跨发行方迁移；KIE系统在布局偏离时性能下降；基准数据集（如SROIE、FUNSD）采用狭窄的字段模式，无法覆盖全面的业务字段集。实际商业发票处理中，同一业务字段在不同组织间会出现不同的标签字符串、空间位置和表格列结构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 视觉-语言模型（Vision-Language Model）；位置感知提示（Position-aware Extraction Prompts）；两阶段调用序列（Two-stage Call Sequence）；人机协同（Human-in-the-loop）；设计理由驱动的流水线架构（Design-rationale-grounded Pipeline）。
AI.method: 1. OCR-free流水线：直接向视觉-语言模型提交文档图像；2. 使用位置感知提取提示；3. 两阶段调用序列结构化输出；4. 人机交互验证界面处理残余错误；5. 在1000张标注商业发票（11个业务字段）上评估；6. 与6种OCR服务、3种KIE系统、8种替代视觉-语言模型配置进行十项比较基准测试；7. 12名参与者试点测试操作可行性。
AI.findings: 1. 文档级精确匹配率达0.97，无需监督适应发票布局；2. 平均处理时间10秒，每份文档成本0.01美元；3. 12名参与者试点表明对测试的顾问群体具有操作可行性；4. 在跨异构发票布局方面优于对比的OCR服务、KIE系统和替代视觉-语言模型配置。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了设计理由驱动的流水线架构原理，能够在不进行每次发行方重新配置的情况下跨异构发票布局运行。建立了涵盖准确性、处理时间、成本和操作员可用性的多维度评估框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了一种低成本（每份0.01美元）、高效率（10秒/份）的实际可部署发票信息提取方案，无需针对不同发行方进行重新配置，并设计了人机交互验证接口处理残余错误，适合企业级商业发票处理场景。

title: Cultural Alignment: Why Social Policy Must Lead the AI Transition

detail.title: Cultural Alignment: Why Social Policy Must Lead the AI Transition
detail.abstract:
The dominant discourse on artificial intelligence frames displacement as a labour market problem amenable to reskilling programmes, regulatory guardrails, and incremental welfare adjustments. This paper argues that framing is dangerously inadequate. Three converging forces — AI as a new printing press democratising knowledge creation, as a cognitive steam engine commoditising professional expertise, and as the completion of industrialisation through robotics — are compressing what institutions treat as a multi-generational transition into a single political cycle. The result is not a policy challenge but a social contract crisis.

Drawing on Lockean and Rousseauian traditions, the paper identifies a structural paradox at the heart of liberal market economies: displacing workers as producers simultaneously destroys them as consumers, triggering a self-reinforcing cycle of spending contraction, welfare system overwhelm, and erosion of state legitimacy. Each philosophical tradition — including the Confucian collectivism shaping East Asian AI governance — contains its own logic of legitimate withdrawal of authority when the social contract fails. The convergence of these crises across competing civilisational models is historically unprecedented.

The paper introduces the concept of Cultural Alignment: the proposition that technical capability must be matched by intentional transformation of social norms, institutions, education, and collective identity. Regulation is a lagging indicator; ethics frameworks are performative. What is required is a redesign of the social infrastructure through which people derive meaning, status, and security. Universal Basic Income is positioned not as a utopian aspiration but as the minimum viable intervention that severs the displacement-to-collapse cycle — necessary, but insufficient without the broader cultural transformation that makes a post-labour society liveable rather than merely survivable.

Through comparative political analysis, this paper offers social policy scholarship a systems-level architecture for understanding why piecemeal responses to AI will fail, and what a coherent alternative demands.

AI.tldr: 本文论证AI驱动的劳动力替代不是单纯的政策问题，而是一场社会契约危机。三大力量（知识民主化、专业商品化、工业化完成）将多代际转型压缩为单一政治周期，导致生产者与消费者双重身份同步瓦解，形成支出收缩→福利崩溃→国家合法性丧失的自我强化循环。论文提出"文化对齐"概念，主张技术能力必须匹配社会规范、制度与集体认同的自觉转型，并将全民基本收入定位为切断这一循环的最低可行干预。
AI.research_question: 为什么以劳动力市场问题为框架的AI政策回应（再培训、监管、福利调整）存在根本性不足？在AI加速替代劳动的背景下，社会契约面临怎样的结构性危机？
AI.motivation: 主流话语将AI替代视为可通过渐进式政策工具解决的劳动力市场问题，但作者认为这一框架忽视了三大技术力量（知识创造民主化、专业认知商品化、机器人完成工业化）正在将本该多代际的转型压缩为单一政治周期，导致社会契约层面的系统性危机，而非可逐步调整的政策问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 洛克和卢梭的社会契约传统（劳动者作为生产者和消费者的双重身份）；儒家集体主义（东亚AI治理中的权威让渡逻辑）；"文化对齐"概念（技术能力与社会规范、制度、教育、集体认同的协同转型）。
AI.method: 比较政治分析（比较不同文明模型下的社会契约失效逻辑）；理论推演（基于社会契约哲学传统论证AI替代的系统性后果）。
AI.findings: 1）AI同步摧毁劳动者作为生产者和消费者的双重身份，引发支出收缩→福利崩溃→国家合法性丧失的自我强化循环；2）不同哲学传统（西方自由市场、东亚儒家）各自包含社会契约失败时权威让渡的内在逻辑；3）多种文明模型下的危机同步汇聚在历史上是空前的；4）监管是滞后指标，伦理框架是表演性的，需要的是社会基础设施的重建；5）全民基本收入是切断这一循环的最低可行干预，但需配合文化转型才能使后劳动社会"可生活"而不仅仅是"可生存"。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AI替代问题从劳动力市场政策框架重新概念化为社会契约危机；提出"文化对齐"概念作为技术-社会协同转型的理论框架；整合西方社会契约传统与东亚儒家传统，揭示不同文明模型下危机同步汇聚的历史特殊性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供系统性分析架构，解释为什么零散应对（再培训、监管、渐进福利改革）必然失败；明确全民基本收入不是乌托邦而是切断危机循环的最低必要手段；指出仅靠经济干预不够，必须进行社会基础设施（意义、地位、安全感来源）的重建。

title: Heart-Mind Labor: The Third Form of Labor in the Age of Artificial Intelligence
affiliations: TSVC

detail.title: Heart-Mind Labor: The Third Form of Labor in the Age of Artificial Intelligence

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding is reported for this working paper.

detail.abstract: Contemporary anxiety about artificial intelligence often rests on an underexamined inference: if AI substitutes for human labor, human beings will have nothing economically meaningful left to do. This paper argues that the inference confuses the displacement of inherited labor forms with the end of labor itself. Drawing on technological anthropology, task-based theories of automation, the history of agricultural mechanization, the transformation of blacksmithing into metallurgy and machine industry, and the contemporary expansion of care and human-service work, the paper introduces the concept of Heart-Mind Labor. Heart-Mind Labor refers to human labor whose core productive inputs are embodied presence, durable trust, meaning-making, moral responsibility, personhood, and community organization. It includes care, education, counseling, mentoring, ritual, coaching, mediation, community building, and high-trust advisory work, but it is not reducible to emotional labor, affective labor, or the care economy. The central argument is that AI can automate many cognitive tasks, but it cannot fully automate the intersubjective and accountable relations through which human beings recognize one another, assume responsibility for one another, and construct meaning together. Because high-quality Heart-Mind Labor has capacity constraints and cannot be copied like software, it is likely to become a labor-intensive absorber of workers displaced or transformed by AI. At the same time, its economic rewards will not rise automatically: compensation and social status depend on certification, ethics, payment systems, insurance, public investment, reputation, and institutional design. The paper concludes that the key question for post-AI society is not whether humans will still work, but whether societies can recognize, professionalize, and fairly compensate the forms of human labor that become most scarce when information becomes abundant.

AI.tldr: 本文反驳了"AI替代人类劳动意味着人类将无事可做"的流行推论，提出"心脑劳动"（Heart-Mind Labor）概念——即依赖具身在场、持久信任、意义建构、道德责任和人格化关系的劳动形式，认为这类劳动难以被AI完全自动化，将成为后AI时代吸收劳动力的关键领域，但其经济回报取决于制度设计而非自动上升。
AI.research_question: 当AI替代大量认知任务后，人类是否还有经济上有意义的劳动形式？如果有，这些劳动的本质特征、经济逻辑和社会条件是什么？
AI.motivation: 当代对AI的焦虑往往基于一个未经检验的推论：AI替代人类劳动=人类将失去经济活动的意义。作者认为这一推论混淆了"特定劳动形式的替代"与"劳动本身的终结"，需要通过概念创新来澄清后AI时代人类劳动的真实前景。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术人类学、任务型自动化理论、农业机械化历史、铁匠转型为冶金和机器工业的历史、护理与人类服务工作的当代扩张。
AI.method: 跨学科概念分析与历史比较研究，从技术人类学、经济史、劳动社会学等多学科视角构建理论论证。
AI.findings: （1）AI可以自动化许多认知任务，但无法完全自动化主体间性和可问责的人际关系。（2）高质量心脑劳动存在容量约束，无法像软件一样复制，因此可能成为吸纳被AI替代或改造的劳动者的劳动密集型领域。（3）心脑劳动的经济回报不会自动上升，而是取决于认证体系、伦理规范、支付系统、保险、公共投资、声誉和制度设计。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"心脑劳动"（Heart-Mind Labor）这一新概念，将其与情感劳动、情感劳动和照护经济区分开来，建立了从劳动本体论角度理解AI与人类劳动关系的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为后AI社会提供政策启示：核心问题不是人类是否还会工作，而是社会能否识别、专业化并公平补偿那些当信息变得丰裕时变得最为稀缺的人类劳动形式。

title: The Role of Foresight in Bridging the Gap between Trends and Customer Experiences
affiliations: University of Zurich and Lufthansa

detail.title: The Role of Foresight in Bridging the Gap between Trends and Customer Experiences
detail.abstract: Anticipating trends and adapting strategies to navigate an increasingly dynamic and complex business environment are essential for organisational success. This paper explores key challenges in effective decision-making, with a focus on integrating foresight practices into strategy and leadership at SWISS International Airlines. It identifies significant gaps between the recognition of emerging trends and their translation into tangible customer value. To address the need for a systematic approach to embedding foresight into the travel experience, we advocate for stronger intraorganisational collaboration. Such collaboration enhances communication and is essential for managing the intricacies of large, multi-layered organisations while ensuring strategic alignment across functional and hierarchical boundaries. By positioning foresight as a foundational element of strategic planning, organisations can unlock new pathways for customer value, foster innovation, and strengthen resilience. This approach not only bridges the gap between trend identification and customer experience but also offers transferable insights for other industries aiming to leverage foresight as a source of strategic advantage. Key points • Strategic foresight can help organisations leverage industry trends, providing a competitive edge. • Detecting weak signals-early indicators of change-to proactively develop trends, can enhance the customer experience and drive innovation. • Through intra-organisational collaboration, managers can mitigate biases and enhance objectivity in the trend analysis and decision-making processes. • Future customer journeys can be more effectively developed by embracing strategic foresight at the corporate level, supported by strong leadership commitment.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了如何通过将战略远见融入SWISS国际航空公司的战略与领导力中，以弥合趋势识别与客户价值转化之间的差距，强调跨部门协作、弱信号检测和领导力承诺对提升决策质量与客户体验的重要性。
AI.research_question: 在动态复杂的商业环境中，企业如何将战略远见有效整合到决策与领导力中，以弥合新兴趋势识别与客户价值转化之间的鸿沟？
AI.motivation: 企业普遍存在"识别了趋势却无法转化为实际客户价值"的困境，缺乏系统性的远见嵌入方法，因此需要探索跨部门协作与战略远见在大型多层次组织中的应用路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 战略远见（Strategic Foresight）、弱信号检测（Weak Signals）、跨组织协作（Intra-organisational Collaboration）、领导力承诺（Leadership Commitment）
AI.method: 以SWISS国际航空公司为案例的定性研究，聚焦于远见实践在战略与领导力中的整合过程。
AI.findings: 1) 战略远见可帮助企业利用行业趋势获得竞争优势；2) 检测弱信号并主动开发趋势能提升客户体验与创新；3) 跨部门协作可减轻管理者偏见、提高趋势分析的客观性；4) 在高层领导承诺的支持下，企业层面拥抱战略远见能更有效地开发未来客户旅程。
AI.theory_contributions: 将战略远见理论与组织协作、领导力理论相结合，提出了从趋势识别到客户价值转化的系统性框架，丰富了战略远见在大型服务型企业中的应用研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为SWISS及类似大型组织提供了嵌入战略远见的具体路径，包括强化跨部门沟通、培养弱信号检测能力、以及通过领导承诺推动远见落地的可操作建议，对其他行业也具有借鉴意义。

title: Investment Dynamics and Market Power In the U.S. Oil and Gas Industry
affiliations: Georgetown University

detail.title: Investment Dynamics and Market Power In the U.S. Oil and Gas Industry
detail.abstract: This paper examines how ownership structure shapes investment in the U.S. oil and gas exploration and production industry. Using more than 356,000 well-level drilling decisions from 2010 to 2023, I compare how public and private firms adjust drilling in response to oil price changes. I find that public firms have become substantially less responsive to oil price increases than private firms. From 2016 onward, private firms’ drilling decisions were roughly twice as sensitive to oil prices as those of public firms, with the gap concentrated in high-price periods. This divergence is not explained by mechanisms emphasized in prior work on ownership structure and investment, including differences in financing frictions, scale, or technology. I interpret these patterns through a stylized framework in which firms with greater influence over input markets restrain drilling when prices are high in order to avoid bidding up the costs of rigs, labor, and completion services. I also provide evidence that financial market pressure helps sustain this restraint. Using 15,000 analyst reports on U.S. oil and gas firms, I show that analyst attention to investment rose sharply after the 2014–2015 oil price collapse and that analysts have since become increasingly supportive of capital discipline and less favorable toward higher capital spending. Stock price reactions also vary systematically with the tone of analyst commentary. The findings show that financial markets can discourage expansion even in favorable market conditions, with implications for competition, energy supply, and regulatory oversight.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2010-2023年超过35.6万口油井的钻探决策数据，发现美国上市公司对油价上涨的钻探响应远低于私营企业（约低一倍），且这一差距集中在高油价时期。原因并非传统融资约束或规模差异，而是上市公司因担心推高投入成本而主动克制钻探，加之金融市场的资本纪律压力（分析师关注度上升且更支持克制）强化了这一行为。
AI.research_question: 所有权结构（上市公司 vs 私营企业）如何影响美国石油天然气行业对油价变化的钻探投资决策？
AI.motivation: 传统文献多从融资约束或管理者短视角度解释所有权结构对投资的影响，但本文发现了一个新的、未被充分解释的现象：上市公司在高油价时期反而比私营企业更不积极投资，这挑战了既有理论，需要新的解释框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 投入品市场影响力框架：拥有更大市场影响力的公司（上市公司）会在高油价时主动克制钻探，以避免推高钻机、劳动力和服务等投入品成本。同时引入金融市场压力（分析师关注与资本纪律）作为维持这种克制行为的机制。
AI.method: 实证分析：超过35.6万口油井层面的钻探决策数据（2010-2023），比较上市公司与私营企业对油价变化的响应差异；额外使用约1.5万份分析师报告进行文本分析，研究分析师对投资态度的变化。
AI.findings: ①2016年后，私营企业对油价的钻探敏感度约为上市公司的两倍，差距集中在高油价时期；②传统机制（融资约束、规模、技术）无法解释这一差异；③分析师对投资的关注度在2014-2015年油价暴跌后显著上升，且越来越支持资本纪律、反对高资本支出；④股票回报与分析师的措辞基调系统相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并检验了"投入品市场影响力"这一新机制来解释所有权结构与投资行为的关系；揭示了金融市场压力（分析师关注和资本纪律）作为外部治理机制如何抑制上市公司扩张。
AI.practical_contributions: 对能源供应安全、市场竞争格局和监管政策有直接启示：上市公司在有利市场条件下也可能不扩张，意味着能源供给弹性可能低于预期，监管者需关注所有权结构对行业产出的影响。

title: Directors’ Duties in the Age of Agentic Artificial Intelligence: How Can Boards Navigate Corporate Purpose and the Stakeholder Interests of Employees Around AI Adoption?

detail.title: Directors’ Duties in the Age of Agentic Artificial Intelligence: How Can Boards Navigate Corporate Purpose and the Stakeholder Interests of Employees Around AI Adoption?
detail.abstract: As boards engage with the adoption of artificial intelligence (AI), including agentic AI to drive operational efficiencies, this presents new opportunities for profit maximization. AI adoption is increasingly identified with employee role displacement in companies, and the interests of employees as stakeholders require exploration. A novel question posed is whether, in an age of AI ascendancy, AI may warrant being given stakeholder status as its role in the company approximates or eclipses that of human employees. The article probes four distinct models of corporate purpose within the directors' duty to act in the best interests of the company-the shareholder primacy model, the Enlightened Shareholder Value model, the stakeholder friendly model and the stakeholder value model, highlighting the available scope for directors to accommodate the interests of employees around AI adoption in decision-making by boards around AI. It is concluded that, given the degree to which directors are insulated from legal scrutiny in relation to their best interests duty, adopting a wider law in context approach to promote employee welfare would serve the interests of employees, directors and companies alike. This would see directors engaging meaningfully with employees and providing opportunities for reskilling to adapt to the age of AI.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了企业在采用人工智能（包括代理型AI）提升运营效率的过程中，AI是否应被赋予利益相关者地位，以及董事如何在四种公司目的模型下兼顾员工利益。结论是，鉴于董事在“最佳利益”义务上享有较大法律裁量空间，采取更广泛的“法律-情境”方法促进员工福祉，对员工、董事和公司三方均有利。
AI.research_question: 在AI崛起的时代，AI是否应被赋予利益相关者地位？董事如何在履行“为公司最佳利益行事”义务时，兼顾AI采用对员工利益的影响？
AI.motivation: AI采用日益导致员工岗位被替代，员工作为利益相关者的利益需要被审视，同时AI在公司中的角色正接近甚至超越人类员工，引发AI是否应被视为利益相关者的新问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 四种公司目的模型：股东至上模型、开明股东价值模型、利益相关者友好模型和利益相关者价值模型；以及董事的“最佳利益”义务与法律审查的绝缘程度。
AI.method: 理论分析与模型比较，采用“法律-情境”（law in context）方法进行规范性论证。
AI.findings: 董事在履行“最佳利益”义务时享有较大法律裁量空间；采用更广泛的“法律-情境”方法促进员工福利，比起僵化遵循某一模型，更能同时服务于员工、董事和公司的利益；具体做法包括与员工进行有意义的互动并提供再技能培训机会以适应AI时代。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出AI可能被赋予利益相关者地位的理论可能性；系统比较四种公司目的模型在AI治理情境下的适用性；将“法律-情境”方法引入公司治理与AI伦理的交叉领域。
AI.practical_contributions: 为董事会在AI决策中处理员工利益提供了可操作的建议，包括推动员工再技能培训、加强董事会与员工的实质性沟通，以及如何利用法律裁量空间平衡各方利益。

title: A Formal Distinction between Black Swans and Zero-Precedent Risks

detail.title: A Formal Distinction between Black Swans and Zero-Precedent Risks

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that the research was conducted in the absence of any commercial, financial, or underlying institutional relationships that could be construed as a potential conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This manuscript is a purely theoretical research paper. It does not contain any studies with human participants or animals performed by the author.
declarations.funderStatement: The author received no financial support for the research, authorship, and/or publication of this article.

detail.abstract: A rigorous formal distinction is established between two modes of rendering unforeseeable risk, routinely conflated in the risk-theoretic and security literature: those underlying the notions of the Black Swan and the Zero-precedent risk. Working within mathematical logic and the metatheory of formal systems, the paper shows that, under the proposed formalisation, the two representational regimes are separated by the boundary between object language and metalanguage: in the former case, the risk already has an object-language formula, although that formula remains deductively unsettled; in the latter case, no such object-language formula is available at all. Relative to a fixed object theory, the formal analogue of a Black Swan is modelled as a well-formed but deductively independent formula – neither provable nor refutable – whereas the formal analogue of a Zero-precedent risk is a metalanguage representation of a risk admitting no object-language representation whatever. The separation is effected by a single predicate of object-language membership; the non-emptiness of the Black Swan class is secured by the Gödel–Rosser incompleteness theorem, while the existence of Zero-precedent risks is taken as a substantive premise. It is further shown that the identification of the two modes is undefinable within the object language: no formula of the ground system can express it, since such an identification requires a tacit ascent to the metalanguage. The result is therefore one about representations, not about events: it distinguishes two ways of formally rendering a risk, not two empirical classes of risk. A methodological corollary is drawn for adaptive security: whereas the mitigation of Black Swans admits of structural redundancy, the governance of Zero-precedent risks demands systemic transmorphance – the capacity of an architecture to reconfigure its own alphabet upon encountering undecodable inputs.

AI.tldr: 本文在数学逻辑和形式系统元理论框架下，严格区分了"黑天鹅"与"零先例风险"这两种不可预见风险的形式化表征模式，证明前者是对象语言中不可判定的公式，后者则根本不存在对象语言表征。这一区分不可在对象语言内定义，并提出了适应性安全的"跨形态转换"方法论启示。
AI.research_question: 黑天鹅风险与零先例风险在形式表征上是否存在根本性的逻辑区别？这种区别如何用数学逻辑和形式系统元理论来刻画？
AI.motivation: 风险理论和安全文献中经常混淆两种不可预见风险模式，但缺乏严格的逻辑区分。作者试图通过数学逻辑（对象语言与元语言的边界）来建立这一区分，并探讨其对适应性安全治理的启示。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数学逻辑：对象语言与元语言区分；哥德尔-罗塞尔不完备定理；形式系统的可判定性与不可定义性。
AI.method: 形式逻辑分析，基于对象语言与元语言的边界划分，运用哥德尔-罗塞尔不完备定理证明黑天鹅类的非空性，并通过逻辑论证说明两种模式的等同不可在对象语言内定义。
AI.findings: (1) 黑天鹅：对象语言中有良构公式，但演绎上不可判定（既不可证也不可否）；(2) 零先例风险：根本不存在任何对象语言表征，仅有元语言表征；(3) 两种模式的等同无法在对象语言内定义，需要隐性上升到元语言；(4) 黑天鹅缓解依赖结构冗余，零先例风险治理需要系统"跨形态转换"能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 为黑天鹅与零先例风险提供了严格的形式逻辑区分基础，将风险表征问题锚定在对象语言与元语言的哲学/逻辑边界上，丰富了风险理论的形式化基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 对适应性安全治理提出方法论启示：应对黑天鹅可采用结构冗余；应对零先例风险则需要架构层面的"跨形态转换"——即系统在面对不可解码输入时重构自身字母表的能力。

title: The Objective-Authority Gap: When Practice Authority Overrides Product Accountability

detail.title: The Objective-Authority Gap: When Practice Authority Overrides Product Accountability
detail.abstract:
This paper develops and stress-tests the Objective-Authority Gap Model using peer-reviewed literature and four reproducible historical case studies. The central claim is not that practices such as QA, security, architecture, infrastructure, product office, and engineering are harmful. It is that practice capability becomes politically damaging when it turns into hidden command over product trade-offs without carrying product outcome accountability. 
The study uses peer-reviewed research in organizational behavior, product development, matrix organization, psychological safety, accountability, decision speed, and organizational politics together with four reproducible official investigation records: Boeing 737 MAX, NASA Columbia, NASA Challenger, and Deepwater Horizon. The cases are not a representative sample, but they provide convergent evidence of a repeated structural pattern across independent failures. No new field data are collected. A synthetic survey demonstration shows how the framework can be applied prospectively inside an organization. 
OAGM formalizes the practical test: identify the product goal, identify who actually holds decision authority, and compare them. In the model, (G) captures whether the product goal governs trade-offs, while (F) captures how fragmented effective decision rights are. Their interaction, (F(1-G)), represents the condition in which weak goal authority meets distributed command. The model is diagnostic and mechanism-based, rather than a new field-estimated causal model. Its parameters are literature-anchored or directionally assumed, all four scored cases are failure-mode organizations, and cross-level inference from individual-level politics research to team-level outcomes remains uncertain. Its practical value is diagnostic: organizations can make the goal-authority gap visible by measuring who can decide, who can block, and whether practice authority is serving product capability or exercising product command.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并检验了“目标-权威鸿沟模型”（OAGM），指出当实践能力（如QA、安全、架构等）从赋能产品变为隐蔽的产品决策权、却无需承担产品结果责任时，就会产生政治性损害。通过四个重大事故案例（波音737 MAX、NASA哥伦比亚号、NASA挑战者号、深水地平线）的再现分析，验证了这一结构性模式。
AI.research_question: 实践能力在什么条件下从组织资产转变为政治性损害？如何诊断组织中的“目标-权威鸿沟”？
AI.motivation: 组织中各实践部门（QA、安全、架构等）拥有专业权威，但若其决策权与产品目标责任脱钩，可能导致重大失败。现有研究缺乏一个可操作的诊断模型来识别这种结构性风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 目标-权威鸿沟模型（OAGM）：(G)表示产品目标是否主导权衡决策，(F)表示有效决策权的碎片化程度，两者交互项(F(1-G))代表“弱目标权威+分布式指挥”的危险状态。
AI.method: 基于同行评审文献与四个可复现的官方调查报告（波音737 MAX、哥伦比亚号、挑战者号、深水地平线）进行历史案例研究。采用合成调查演示展示前瞻性应用。属于机制诊断型模型，而非新田野数据估算的因果模型。
AI.findings: 四个重大失败案例均呈现一致的结构性模式：实践部门拥有隐蔽的产品权衡决策权，但无需承担产品结果责任。目标-权威鸿沟是可诊断的：通过识别谁能决策、谁能阻挡、实践权威是在服务产品能力还是行使产品命令来进行测量。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了“目标-权威鸿沟”这一新构念，将组织政治、心理安全、矩阵组织等分散文献整合为一个可操作的诊断框架。形式化了实践权威从能力赋能到隐蔽命令的转化条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个可复现的诊断工具，帮助组织识别实践部门是否越界行使产品命令。通过测量决策权与目标责任的匹配度，组织可以提前发现结构性风险，避免类似波音737 MAX等重大失败。

title:
No One Can Own the Language of Medicine
The Legal and Economic Case for an Open, AI-native Standard for Coding Medical Interventions

detail.title:
No One Can Own the Language of Medicine
The Legal and Economic Case for an Open, AI-native Standard for Coding Medical Interventions

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is an emergency physician and an independent researcher with an interest in open standards for medical information and in services that may be built on such standards. One of those standards is the Universal Document standard referenced in Part V of this Article, which is published under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International license, with a free and vendor-neutral software development kit, no licensing fee on the format itself, and no affiliate-licensing requirement. The OMNI standard proposed in this Article sits in the same family on the same terms; both are offered for unrestricted public use under open licenses. The author has no financial relationship with the American Medical Association, with any organization that licenses or markets Current Procedural Terminology, or with any organization that would benefit financially from the continuation of the present arrangement. The author has not received any payment, grant, consulting fee, honorarium, or in-kind support for the preparation of this Article. The argument of the Article does not depend on the author's interest in open standards, and the case for replacing CPT does not change if a party other than the author or the open-standards community he is associated with builds the replacement. This statement is offered for full candor and goes beyond the minimum disclosure most journals require.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This Article is doctrinal and policy scholarship analyzing federal regulation, copyright doctrine, and the architecture of medical coding standards. It does not report research involving human subjects, patient data, identifiable participants, animal subjects, or clinical case material. No institutional review board approval was required, and no patient or participant consent was obtained because none was implicated. The Article references publicly available federal court decisions, federal statutes and regulations, federal agency materials, public reporting, and published scholarly literature; all such sources are cited.

This Article was researched and written by the author without grant support, institutional sponsorship, consulting income, contractual relationship, or in-kind support from any organization. No funder had any role in the conception, research, drafting, revision, or decision to submit the work.

detail.abstract:
In America, the language of medicine is leased back to the people who speak it. Every billable act has to be named in a code that a private trade association owns and rents back. The American Medical Association holds the copyright to Current Procedural Terminology (CPT), the federal government has mandated its use since the 1980s, and the licensing revenue runs into the hundreds of millions of dollars a year. This paper argues that the arrangement is difficult to justify on legal, economic, or clinical grounds, and that a credible open alternative is now technically straightforward and politically possible.

The legal terrain is more contested than is usually assumed. The case that shields the CPT copyright also found the AMA misused it, the modern authority on standards incorporated into law favors public access, and the federal government can open the field by rulemaking without a single new statute. The technical objection that an open standard is hard to build does not survive contact with the facts: the composable, machine-readable model is already standardized by the World Health Organization’s International Classification of Health Interventions (ICHI) and by SNOMED CT. The missing piece is governance, not computer science. This paper sets out that governance model under the working name OMNI, for Open Medical Nomenclature and Interventions, and maps a realistic adoption path through the interoperability machinery the United States already built under the 21st Century Cures Act. Administrative activity consumed an estimated 34 percent of US health spending in 2017, roughly 812 billion dollars; a licensed bottleneck on the basic vocabulary of care is a small but symbolic piece of that, and a fixable one.

AI.tldr: 本文批判美国医学会（AMA）对《当前程序术语》（CPT）编码系统的版权垄断，指出该安排在法律、经济及临床层面均难获正当性，并提出建立一个名为OMNI（开放医学命名与干预）的开放标准替代方案，利用现有国际分类体系（WHO的ICHI和SNOMED CT）和美国《21世纪治愈法案》的互操作性基础设施，实现可行替代路径。
AI.research_question: 美国医学会（AMA）对CPT编码系统的版权垄断在法律、经济和临床上是否合理？是否存在可行的开放替代方案？
AI.motivation: 美国医疗行政成本高昂（2017年占医疗支出的34%，约8120亿美元），而CPT编码作为医疗服务的核心词汇被私人协会垄断并收取高额许可费，这一"语言租赁"制度在学术上鲜有深入批判，作者认为需要一个可行的开放替代方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 法律分析（版权法、标准纳入法规的公法逻辑）、经济学分析（许可垄断与行政成本）、信息科学（可组合、机器可读的医疗分类标准，如ICHI和SNOMED CT）。
AI.method: 法律判例分析（分析保护CPT版权的判例中亦发现AMA滥用版权的部分）、技术可行性论证（论证已有国际开放标准如ICHI和SNOMED CT可作为基础）、治理模型设计（提出OMNI开放标准及治理架构）、政策路径分析（基于美国《21世纪治愈法案》的互操作性机制）。
AI.findings: 保护CPT版权的判例同时发现AMA存在滥用版权行为；技术障碍不存在，因为WHO的ICHI和SNOMED CT已提供可组合、机器可读的开放模型；联邦政府无需新立法，仅需通过规则制定即可开放该领域；行政活动消耗了美国约8120亿美元的医疗支出。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了医疗编码版权垄断的正当性理论基础，揭示了法律判例中被忽视的"滥用"维度；整合法律、经济、技术多个学科视角，为医疗标准治理提供跨学科分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出OMNI开放医疗命名与干预系统的具体治理模型；指出利用现有国际标准和《21世纪治愈法案》互操作性基础设施的可行实施路径；为降低美国医疗行政成本提供可操作的制度方案。

title: To Accept or Deflect Praise? Examining the Social Consequences of Compliment Responses
affiliations: Rice University, Jesse H. Jones Graduate School of Business, Department of Statistics, Students and Georgetown University

detail.title: To Accept or Deflect Praise? Examining the Social Consequences of Compliment Responses

declarations.ethicsApproval: The studies described in this manuscript were approved by the Research Ethics Committees at Rice University (IRB-FY2024-231) and Georgetown University (IRB # 00006839). All studies except for Supplemental Study 1 were pre-registered.

detail.abstract: Compliments can benefit recipients, givers, and their relationships, but responding to them can be surprisingly complex. Across four preregistered studies (N = 2,056 adults online and in the lab), deflecting (vs. accepting) compliments reliably produced negative consequences for how recipients were perceived. Though deflecting had mixed effects on perceived humility relative to accepting—at times, decreasing, increasing, or having no effect on humility—recipients who deflected (vs. accepted) compliments were consistently seen as less warm, less competent, and less likable both across recalled real interactions (Study 1) and controlled scenarios (Studies 2-3). These effects were mediated by lower perceived relational receptivity: Compliment givers saw recipients as less aligned with their positive view, which in turn led to these negative social evaluations (Study 3). Subsequently, these negative social perceptions resulted in behavioral consequences: Recipients who deflected were less likely to be chosen as future work partners relative to those who accepted (Study 4). Together, these findings reveal the negative social consequences of deflecting praise and identify relational receptivity as a key mechanism through which everyday conversational responses shape social evaluation.

AI.tldr: 面对赞美时，拒绝（vs.接受）赞美会让赞美者感到对方缺乏"关系接纳性"，从而认为该人不太温暖、不太能干、不太讨人喜欢，甚至不愿与其合作。
AI.research_question: 面对赞美时，拒绝（deflecting）相比接受（accepting）赞美，会产生怎样的社会后果？其背后的机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 赞美在社交中很常见，但回应赞美却是一件复杂的事。以往文献关注了赞美本身的好处，但较少探讨接受与拒绝赞美对社交评价的不同影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 关系接纳性（relational receptivity）理论：赞美给予者希望自己的积极评价被对方接纳，若对方拒绝赞美，则会被视为与自己的积极观点不一致，从而引发负面社会评价。
AI.method: 四项预注册研究（总N=2,056），包括线上和实验室实验：研究1为回忆法；研究2-3为受控情景实验；研究4为行为结果实验（工作伙伴选择）。
AI.findings: （1）拒绝赞美的人被一致认为更不温暖、更不称职、更不讨人喜欢；（2）拒绝赞美对谦逊感知的影响不一致（有时增强、有时减弱、有时无影响）；（3）上述效应由关系接纳性中介——拒绝赞美使给予者感到对方不接纳自己的积极观点；（4）拒绝赞美的人更少被选为未来的工作伙伴。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了回应赞美这一日常对话行为如何通过"关系接纳性"机制影响社会评价，拓展了赞美互动与印象形成领域的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒人们在社交和职场中接受赞美可能比谦虚拒绝更有利；为沟通培训、面试技巧等实践提供证据支持。

title: AI-Augmented Research Productivity Theory (AARPT)

detail.title: AI-Augmented Research Productivity Theory (AARPT)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The data analysis process employed thematic analysis and theoretical integration to systematically examine and synthesize the collected scholarly literature on Artificial Intelligence and research productivity. Thematic analysis was used to identify, classify, and interpret recurring patterns, concepts, and ideas across the reviewed studies. This involved carefully reading and re-reading the literature to extract meaningful units of information related to AI-assisted research processes, human cognitive involvement, productivity enhancement, and ethical considerations. After initial coding of key ideas, similar codes were grouped into broader themes such as AI-supported efficiency, human cognitive contribution, technology adoption behavior, cognitive load management, and ethical use of AI in research. These themes were then analyzed to understand their relationships and relevance to research productivity in academic settings. In addition, theoretical integration was applied to connect findings from different foundational theories, including Social Cognitive Theory, Technology Acceptance Model, Cognitive Load Theory, and AI Ethics frameworks. This integration allowed the study to construct a unified conceptual explanation of how AI tools and human cognitive skills interact in research environments. Through this process, the study developed a coherent theoretical structure that supports the formulation of the AI-Augmented Research Productivity Theory (AARPT).

The research was independently conducted by the author as part of a conceptual scholarly work focused on the development of the AI-Augmented Research Productivity Theory (AARPT). detail.abstract: The increasing integration of Artificial Intelligence into academic and research environments has fundamentally changed the way knowledge is generated, data analyzed, and scholarly output produced by scholars. Despite the increasing use of AI tools for writing, data analysis, and literature synthesis, there is limited theoretical explanation of how AI can increase research productivity while sustaining human intellectual contributions. This focus proposed the AI-Augmented Research Productivity Theory (AARPT), which explained how AI systems improve research productivity by engaging human thinking skills including critical thinking, methodological awareness, and analytical analysis. Using a conceptual research design, the theory integrates literature from educational technology, research methodology, cognitive science, and AI ethics. The theory goes that the best research productivity occurs when AI tools and human researchers work in a synergistic and balanced relationship. The framework provides a foundation for extended empirical validation across academic disciplines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了AI增强研究生产力理论（AARPT），解释AI如何通过激活人类的批判性思维、方法意识和分析能力来提升研究生产力，强调人机协同平衡是实现最佳研究生产力的关键。
AI.research_question: AI如何在提升研究生产力的同时保持人类智力贡献？人机协同的最佳机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 尽管AI在研究中的应用越来越广泛，但缺乏一个系统的理论框架来解释AI如何提升研究生产力，同时保证人类智力的核心贡献不受侵蚀。
AI.theoretical_framework: AI增强研究生产力理论（AARPT），整合了教育技术、研究方法论、认知科学和AI伦理领域的文献。
AI.method: 概念研究设计，通过跨学科文献整合构建理论框架。
AI.findings: 最佳研究生产力发生在AI工具与人类研究者之间建立协同平衡关系时；AI通过激活人类的批判性思维、方法意识和分析能力来提升研究产出。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了AARPT这一新的理论框架，为理解AI与人类协作提升研究生产力提供了系统化的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究者合理使用AI工具、平衡AI辅助与人类智力投入提供了理论指导；为跨学科实证验证提供了基础框架。

title: Building a Statistical Bridge Between Hedge Funds and Private Markets Universes: A Framework for Improving Return Time Series Estimation
affiliations: FERI Trust GmbH, FERI Trust GmbH, FERI Trust GmbH,  and FERI Trust GmbH

detail.title: Building a Statistical Bridge Between Hedge Funds and Private Markets Universes: A Framework for Improving Return Time Series Estimation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors are affiliated with FERI AG company. The authors declare that there are no competing financial or personal interests that influenced this work.

detail.abstract: This paper develops a unified Bayesian state-space framework for harmonizing risk measurement across hedge funds (HF) and private markets (PM) funds, two alternative asset classes that differ fundamentally in data frequency, pricing transparency, liquidity, and distributional properties. Hedge funds report monthly NAVs but may exhibit serial correlation from stale pricing; PM funds report quarterly or less frequently with appraisal-based valuations introducing severe return smoothing. Beyond risk measurement, the unified framework has direct practical relevance for liquidity planning: by reconstructing true return dynamics and aligning data frequencies across HF and PM allocations, the approach enables more reliable estimation of drawdown timing, capital call schedules, and liquidity shortfall probabilities, key inputs for institutional investors managing redemption risk. We extend the existing literature along different dimensions relative to first-generation approaches. At the conceptual level, we formally decompose the measurement (smoothing) operator from the economic return-generating process, state explicit identification conditions, and allow for structural autocorrelation in true latent returns via an AR(p) specification that prevents over-unsmoothing bias. Econometrically, we replace Gaussian innovations with t student (or scale-mixture) distributions to capture tail risk, introduce time-varying factor loadings via random-walk state-space dynamics, implement a hierarchical Bayesian framework with strategy-level pooling for small-sample robustness, employ unscented Kalman filtering (UKF) to handle nonlinear quarterly aggregation without log-linear approximation, and estimate the HF and PM systems jointly to improve covariance and tail-dependence estimation. For risk measurement, we correct volatility scaling under autocorrelation using autocovariance-adjusted formulas, estimate VaR and Expected Shortfall via Extreme Value Theory (GPD/peaks-over-threshold), and simulate the full probability distribution of maximum drawdown rather than reporting point estimates. Finally, the paper discusses the main limitations and practical challenges of the proposed framework, including model sensitivity, small-sample instability, and computational complexity. We also highlight the trade-off between methodological sophistication and practical implementability. To address these concerns, the paper outlines simpler complementary frameworks that can be considered.

title: The Impact of Stress Testing on Bank Exposures to Non-Bank Financial Institutions
affiliations: Clemson University

detail.title: The Impact of Stress Testing on Bank Exposures to Non-Bank Financial Institutions

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Author was a student of Clemson University during study
declarations.funderStatement: Clemson University John E. Walker Department of Economics

detail.abstract: This study investigates the impact of stress testing thresholds on bank exposure to Non-Bank Financial Institutions (NBFIs). Using a difference-in-discontinuities design and FR Y-9C data, I examine how regulatory asset thresholds affect risk-taking. Findings reveal that the 2018 regulatory relief triggered a surge in NBFI lending by approximately 4.507 percentage points among exempt banks, while regulated institutions reduced exposure. This suggests that stress testing may inadvertently migrate systemic risk into the shadow banking sector through interconnected financing. The results are suggestive of regulatory arbitrage dynamics and point to open questions regarding systemic risk and the calibration of future stress testing thresholds.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了压力测试阈值对银行与非银行金融机构（NBFI）之间风险敞口的影响，发现2018年监管放松导致受豁免银行对NBFI的贷款增加了约4.507个百分点，而受监管机构则减少了敞口，表明压力测试可能通过互联融资将系统性风险迁移至影子银行部门。
AI.research_question: 压力测试阈值如何影响银行对非银行金融机构（NBFI）的风险敞口？
AI.motivation: 了解监管阈值调整是否会引发监管套利行为，以及这种套利是否会将系统性风险从传统银行体系迁移至影子银行部门。
AI.theoretical_framework: 监管套利理论、系统性风险迁移假说、压力测试阈值效应的理论分析。
AI.method: 采用差异中的不连续设计（difference-in-discontinuities），利用FR Y-9C数据进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 2018年监管放松导致受豁免银行对NBFI的贷款增加约4.507个百分点，而受监管银行则减少了相关敞口，表明存在系统性风险通过互联融资向影子银行迁移的现象。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了压力测试阈值可能产生的意外后果，即监管套利驱动风险向影子银行体系迁移，丰富了系统性风险和监管设计的理论讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者校准未来压力测试阈值提供实证依据，提示需关注监管边界效应和影子银行体系的风险积累。

title: A Tilted Value Function and the Rational Collapse of Matching

detail.title: A Tilted Value Function and the Rational Collapse of Matching
detail.abstract: Why do people who actively seek partners increasingly fail to find them, even when no one behaves foolishly and the world is far from empty? The usual story blames scarcity or rising standards. I argue the real cause is the shape of what people want. Attractiveness works like a threshold: past a certain point, candidates are simply good, and the rest is taste. But media, peers, and shared statistics quietly tilt this flat sense of value into "higher is always better." Everyone then optimizes rationally toward the top of their own scale-yet because they all look upward, they crowd into thin upper edges that rarely overlap. Acceptable partners remain plentiful; the overlap a match needs compresses far faster than the pool. And because matches grow scarce while no one looks foolish, the cause stays hidden.

AI.tldr: 人们找不到伴侣的真正原因并非资源稀缺或要求提高，而是因为吸引力被扭曲为"越高越好"的线性排序，导致所有人理性地追逐顶层却互相拥挤，可接受的对象虽多，但重叠区间急剧压缩，匹配变得越来越困难。
AI.research_question: 为什么积极寻找伴侣的人越来越难以找到伴侣，即使在没有人行为愚蠢且世界远非空荡的情况下？
AI.motivation: 传统解释归因于资源稀缺或标准提高，但本文认为真正原因在于人们偏好的形状——吸引力本应是阈值型（过了某点即"好"），但在媒体、同伴和共享统计的影响下被扭曲成线性排序。
AI.theoretical_framework: 阈值型吸引力理论（门槛效应）、社会比较与偏好扭曲、理性优化下的拥挤效应、匹配重叠区间的压缩机制。
AI.method: 理论论证与概念建模，结合社会心理学与匹配理论进行逻辑推演。
AI.findings: 当所有人都理性地向上优化时，大家会拥挤在很少重叠的顶层边缘；可接受的伴侣仍然丰富，但匹配所需的重叠区间急剧压缩，导致匹配稀少且原因隐蔽。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种新的匹配失败解释机制——偏好形状扭曲而非资源稀缺或标准上升；揭示了"理性个体行为导致集体匹配困境"的悖论。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助人们认识到匹配困难的结构性原因而非自我归因；提示相亲平台或社交策略应关注偏好校准而非单纯扩大候选池。

detail.abstract: New data series from Statistics Canada on the sales of vaping products provide evidence on the extent of illegality in e-cigarette markets, both provincially and federally. This paper address three questions: First, how much of the market is either grey (borderline illegal) or black (definitely illegal)? Second, how does illegality vary by province? Third, with a view to minimizing illegality and promoting regulatory and tax equity across the spectrum of risky products, how should nicotine products be envisaged? We find that the outsourcing of purchases to adjoining provinces, the grey market, is particularly high for those provinces with the strictest product-use regulations-Nova Scotia, British Columbia, Quebec and Saskatchewan. Since product that is banned in those provinces is readily available in both brick-and-mortar stores and from on-line vendors in several other provinces, as well as from vendors on First Nations lands and criminal gangs, restrictive measures in any given province benefit out-of-province vendors, some of which may be legal, and illegal vendors everywhere. In volume terms Quebec stands out. We infer the size of the black market by merging consumption data with legal sales data. It too appears large at this time.

AI.tldr: 本文利用加拿大统计局关于电子烟销售的新数据，研究了电子烟市场的非法程度（灰色市场和黑色市场），分析了各省之间的差异，并探讨了如何在风险产品谱系中实现税收与监管公平以减少非法行为。研究发现，对电子烟产品监管最严格的省份（新斯科舍省、不列颠哥伦比亚省、魁北克省和萨斯喀彻温省）的灰色市场（跨省购买）尤为严重，而黑色市场的规模在当前也相当大。
AI.research_question: 第一，电子烟市场中灰色市场（擦边非法）和黑色市场（明确非法）的规模有多大？第二，各省之间的非法程度有何差异？第三，为最大限度地减少非法行为、促进风险产品谱系中的监管和税收公平，应如何构想尼古丁产品政策？
AI.motivation: 加拿大各省对电子烟产品实施了不同的监管措施，但监管对市场非法行为的影响尚不明确。了解非法市场的规模及其分布，对于制定有效的监管和税收政策、减少非法贸易、促进公平竞争至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 监管溢出效应与跨辖区的替代效应理论。即严格的本地监管会导致消费者转向其他辖区的合法或非法渠道获取产品，从而产生灰色市场和黑色市场。
AI.method: 利用加拿大统计局关于电子烟销售的新数据，结合消费数据与合法销售数据，通过数据合并推断黑色市场规模；同时通过跨省购买行为分析灰色市场。

AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了严格的地方性监管如何导致消费向其他辖区的合法或非法渠道溢出，拓展了监管溢出效应在电子烟市场中的应用。
