title: The Impossibility of a Paretian Environmentalist

detail.title: The Impossibility of a Paretian Environmentalist
detail.abstract: Sen (1970) showed that the Pareto principle is inconsistent with even a minimal commitment to individual liberty under an unrestricted domain. This paper extends his result to environmental values. I argue that the standard market failures of environmental economics-externalities, common-pool resource overuse, and free riding-are precisely the problems that a fully internalized cost-benefit analysis (CBA) is designed to solve, and therefore are not where the deepest conflict between economics and environmentalism lies. The conflict begins where internalization ends. Replacing Sen's condition of minimal liberalism with a condition of minimal environmentalism, I prove that no social decision function can simultaneously satisfy unrestricted domain, the Pareto principle, and the treatment of even two environmental values as decisive. I then show that strong sustainability implies precisely such decisiveness: if certain forms of natural capital are non-substitutable, their preservation is lexically prior to compensating gains elsewhere. The result yields a sharp distinction between weak and strong sustainability. A Paretian environmentalist is possible if and only if she is a weak-sustainability environmentalist, for whom natural and manufactured capital remain commensurable. The paper also contributes to constitutional political economy. The theorem implies that strong-sustainability values cannot be coherently represented within an ordinary welfare criterion. Before asking how political institutions distort environmental decisions, one must ask whether the relevant values can be represented within the criterion those institutions are charged with implementing. The constructive implication is that such values are not ordinary policy objectives but constitutional constraints: they belong among the rules that structure collective choice rather than among the outcomes traded off within it.

AI.tldr: 本文将Sen（1970）关于帕累托原则与个人自由不相容的定理扩展至环境价值领域，证明强可持续性价值无法在普通福利标准内部被一致地表达，而应被理解为宪法层面的约束条件。
AI.research_question: 环境价值与经济学核心原则（帕累托原则、不受限域）之间是否存在深层的不相容性？强可持续性是否无法在普通社会福利函数中得到一致表达？
AI.motivation: 传统环境经济学将环境问题视为市场失灵（外部性、公地悲剧、搭便车），认为成本收益分析（CBA）可以解决。但作者认为，环境主义与经济学的真正冲突发生在内部化完成之后，而非之前。需要揭示这种深层的不相容性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会选择理论（Sen的不可能性定理）；弱可持续性与强可持续性的区分；宪法政治经济学（ Buchanan, Hayek）。
AI.method: 形式化公理证明。将Sen的"最小自由主义"条件替换为"最小环境主义"条件，证明不存在同时满足不受限域、帕累托原则和至少两个环境价值具有决定性的社会决策函数。
AI.findings: （1）不存在同时满足不受限域、帕累托原则和两个环境价值具有决定性的社会决策函数；（2）强可持续性意味着自然资本不可替代，其保护在词典序上优先于来自其他领域的补偿性收益；（3）只有弱可持续性环境主义者才能同时成为帕累托环境主义者；（4）强可持续性价值无法在普通福利标准内被一致表达，应被视为宪法约束而非政策目标。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Sen定理扩展至环境价值领域，揭示了环境主义与经济学福利准则之间的深层逻辑冲突；为弱/强可持续性区分提供了社会选择理论层面的严格基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为环境政策制定提供了宪法层面的指导：强可持续性价值观不应被纳入日常政策权衡，而应作为宪法层面的约束条件来塑造集体选择的基本规则。

title: Practical validation of synthetic pre-crash scenarios
affiliations: Chalmers University of Technology, affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Michigan at Ann Arbor and Chalmers University of Technology

detail.title: Practical validation of synthetic pre-crash scenarios
detail.abstract: The representativeness of synthetic pre-crash scenarios is crucial for assessing the safety impact of Driving Automation Systems through virtual simulations. However, a gap remains in the robust evaluation of synthetic pre-crash scenarios' practical equivalence to their real-world counterparts; that is, whether they are similar enough for the intended assessment purpose. Conventional significance testing is inadequate, as it focuses on detecting differences rather than establishing practical equivalence. This study addresses the research gap by extending our previous work on a Bayesian Region of Practical Equivalence (ROPE)-based equivalence testing framework by introducing a binning-based approach to define appropriate statistics and equivalence criteria. Two binning-based statistics are proposed to measure practically meaningful distributional differences between datasets in the context of safety impact assessment. The framework's applicability is demonstrated through a case study, which tests the practical equivalence of two synthetic rear-end pre-crash datasets with a previously developed reference dataset in the context of the safety impact assessment of an Automatic Emergency Braking system. The results show that the framework provides informative quantitative assessments of practical equivalence as well as diagnostic insights into the divergence of datasets. Although the demonstration focuses on rear-end pre-crash scenarios, the framework is generic and extensible to broader validation contexts, providing an interpretable and principled basis for practical equivalence assessment across diverse synthetic data applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于贝叶斯实用等价区间（ROPE）和分箱方法的框架，用于评估合成预碰撞场景与真实场景的实用等价性，弥补了传统显著性检验无法判断等价性的不足。
AI.research_question: 如何稳健地评估合成预碰撞场景与真实场景在安全影响评估中的实用等价性？
AI.motivation: 合成预碰撞场景的代表性对驾驶自动化系统的安全评估至关重要，但现有方法（传统显著性检验）只能检测差异，无法判断数据集是否“足够相似”以满足评估目的，存在方法论缺口。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贝叶斯实用等价区间（ROPE）框架、分箱方法（binning-based approach）
AI.method: 在先前提出的贝叶斯ROPE等价性测试框架基础上，引入分箱方法定义适当的统计量和等价标准；提出两种基于分箱的统计量来衡量数据集间具有实际意义的分布差异；通过自动紧急制动（AEB）系统的安全影响评估案例进行验证。
AI.findings: 该框架能够提供实用等价性的定量评估，并能诊断数据集之间的分歧来源；案例研究表明，两个合成追尾预碰撞数据集与参考数据集之间的等价性得到了有效评估。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个通用的、可解释的实用等价性评估框架，将贝叶斯ROPE方法扩展到合成数据的验证领域，并引入分箱统计量解决分布差异衡量问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为驾驶自动化系统的安全评估提供了更可靠的合成场景验证工具；框架具有通用性和可扩展性，可应用于更广泛的合成数据验证场景。

title: Bounded Rationality, Monetary Policy, and the Scars of Supply Shocks * †
affiliations: Sapienza University of Rome - Department of Economics and Law, Czech National Bank, Sapienza University of Rome and Sapienza University of Rome

detail.title: Bounded Rationality, Monetary Policy, and the Scars of Supply Shocks * †
detail.abstract: We study monetary policy responses to negative supply disruptions in a New Keynesian model with endogenous productivity growth and bounded rationality. Under rational expectations, tight monetary policy eases the rise in inflation in the short term at the cost of larger declines in demand, investment, and future productivity. With boundedly rational households, agents internalise changes in their permanent income less strongly, mitigating the fall in aggregate demand and future growth following a supply disruption. In this context, a tighter monetary policy stance improves inflation outcomes without generating large scarring effects.

AI.tldr: 本文在新凯恩斯模型中纳入内生生产率增长和有限理性，研究货币政策对负面供给冲击的应对。研究发现，在理性预期下，紧缩货币政策虽短期抑制通胀，但加剧需求、投资和未来生产率的下滑。而在有限理性下，紧缩政策能在改善通胀的同时避免严重的疤痕效应。
AI.research_question: 在存在内生生产率增长和有限理性的经济环境中，货币政策应如何应对负面供给 disruptions？不同的理性预期假设如何影响货币政策的权衡？
AI.motivation: 传统新凯恩斯模型通常假设理性预期，且较少考虑供给冲击对长期生产率增长的内生影响。本文旨在放松理性预期假设，考察有限理性如何改变货币政策应对供给冲击的传导机制和福利后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 新凯恩斯模型、内生生产率增长理论、有限理性理论（特别是永久收入假说的认知局限）
AI.method: 理论建模与数值模拟：构建包含内生生产率增长和有限理性（bounded rationality）的New Keynesian DSGE模型，比较理性预期与有限理性两种情形下货币政策应对供给冲击的效果。
AI.findings: 1. 理性预期下，紧缩货币政策以牺牲未来增长为代价抑制短期通胀；2. 有限理性下，家庭对永久收入变化的内部化程度减弱，供给冲击导致的需求和增长下降幅度更小；3. 此时，紧缩货币政策能有效改善通胀，且不会产生严重的"疤痕效应"（长期产出损失）。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将有限理性引入内生增长的新凯恩斯模型，拓展了货币政策分析的理论边界；2. 揭示了有限理性如何改变供给冲击下货币政策在通胀与增长之间的权衡关系；3. 为理解"牺牲率"（sacrifice ratio）在行为宏观经济学框架下的变化提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为央行在供给冲击（如能源危机、供应链断裂）下制定货币政策提供了理论依据；2. 提示政策制定者：在行为主体有限理性的现实中，紧缩政策抑制通胀的成本可能低于传统模型预测；3. 支持"先紧后稳"的货币政策策略，兼顾短期物价稳定与长期经济增长。

title: How Loss Aversion Is Structurally Embedded in Ireland's Planning System

detail.title: How Loss Aversion Is Structurally Embedded in Ireland's Planning System

declarations.funderStatement: independent researcher who has not received or sought funding

detail.abstract: Ireland's planning system is routinely described as dysfunctional. This paper argues that dysfunction is not incidental but structural: the architecture of the system amplifies loss aversion, a well-documented cognitive bias in which the psychological cost of loss is weighted approximately twice as heavily as an equivalent gain, and simultaneously creates cost asymmetries that enable and incentivise strategic exploitation. Third-party objectors bear negligible financial cost (€20-€50 in administrative fees) while imposing delays measurable in years and financial costs measurable in millions on development applicants. Future residents and prospective housing beneficiaries, whose gains from development approval would be substantial, are structurally absent from the decision-making process. This paper traces the theoretical mechanism by which loss aversion is transmitted through planning institutions, documents the forms of strategic exploitation the cost asymmetry enables, examines the political economy of reform inaction, and proposes targeted legislative and architectural interventions. The argument is not that objection rights should be eliminated, but that the current system has decoupled the right to object from any proportionate accountability for the costs of that objection.

AI.tldr: 本文论证爱尔兰规划系统的功能失调是结构性而非偶然的：系统架构放大了损失厌恶的认知偏见，并创造了成本不对称，使第三方反对者能以极低成本（€20-50）对开发商造成数百万欧元的延误损失，而未来住房受益者却被结构性排除在决策过程之外。
AI.research_question: 爱尔兰规划系统为何持续功能失调？其结构性缺陷如何通过损失厌恶机制和成本不对称被放大和利用？
AI.motivation: 爱尔兰规划系统频繁被描述为功能失调，但现有讨论多停留在现象层面。本文试图从行为经济学和政治经济学的角度，揭示系统功能障碍的结构性根源，而非简单归咎于个别行为者或政策失误。
AI.theoretical_framework: 损失厌恶（loss aversion）理论——心理上损失的权重约为等量收益的两倍；成本不对称分析；政治经济学的改革惰性理论。
AI.method: 理论机制追踪（tracing the theoretical mechanism），结合制度分析与案例论证，辅以成本收益的结构性比较。
AI.findings: （1）规划系统的制度架构系统性地放大损失厌恶偏差；（2）成本不对称使反对者能以微小代价施加巨大延误成本，并激励策略性利用；（3）未来住房受益者被结构性排除，导致支持开发的利益方在决策过程中缺位；（4）上述机制共同构成了改革的政治经济惰性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将行为经济学中的损失厌恶理论引入规划系统分析，提出"制度性损失厌恶放大"的理论机制；系统化阐述了成本不对称如何催生策略性利用行为。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出针对性的立法和制度架构改革建议；明确指出改革方向应是让反对权利与成本承担相称，而非消除反对权本身。

title: On Semantic Drift: Structural Differentiation, Dynamic Evolution, and Coordination Risks in Socio-Technical Systems
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: On Semantic Drift: Structural Differentiation, Dynamic Evolution, and Coordination Risks in Socio-Technical Systems
detail.abstract:
In highly digitalized, platformized, and AI-driven socio-technical systems, high-centrality lexical items are undergoing a structural semantic drift: their meaning structures are gradually differentiating across various groups, reality anchors are weakening, and narrative couplings are intensifying, ultimately culminating in a systemic failure of shared semantic protocols. This study proposes a fourlayer analytical framework to elucidate the formation mechanisms, dynamic structures, systemic risks, and potential governance pathways of semantic drift. 

The first layer integrates cybernetics and systems theory to define semantic drift as a structural phenomenon, clarifying its endogenous dialectical relationship with social fragmentation. The second layer introduces 'Semantic Drift Dynamics' to analyze how platform recommendation architectures, AI narrative smoothing, institutional incentive compatibility, and discursive competition collectively drive the expansion of conceptual boundaries. The third layer demonstrates the structural consequences of semantic drift, including false shared semantics, coordination protocol mismatch, the attenuation of empirical error-correction loops, and a civilizational decline in large-scale collaboration capabilities, offering a neutral deconstruction through the cases of the Russia-Ukraine conflict and the semantic expansion of 'developmental security'. The fourth layer proposes the 'Semantic Stabilization Framework (SSF)' as a non-content-centric thought experiment designed to maintain the baseline semantic interoperability of high-centrality vocabulary, thereby providing a reflexive structural warning for modern civilization. Building upon established traditions in classical social sciences (Sartori, 1970; Luhmann, 1995; Habermas, 1989), this study elevates semantic drift from a purely linguistic phenomenon to a systemic risk impacting macro-societal synergy and institutional operations.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个四层分析框架，系统阐释了数字化与AI驱动的社会技术系统中核心词汇的语义漂移现象——其结构表现为意义分化、现实锚点弱化与叙事耦合加剧，最终导致共享语义协议的系统性失效，并提出“语义稳定框架（SSF）”作为维护高中心性词汇基线语义互操作性的治理思路。
AI.research_question: 在高度数字化、平台化和AI驱动的社会技术系统中，高中心性词汇的语义漂移是如何形成的？其动态结构、系统性风险及治理路径是什么？
AI.motivation: 传统语义研究多将语义漂移视为纯语言学现象，但本文将其提升为影响宏观社会协同与制度运行的系统性风险，以回应数字时代社会碎片化与共享意义崩溃的紧迫问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 控制论、系统论、Luhmann的社会系统理论、Habermas的交往行为理论、Sartori的概念分析传统，以及平台推荐架构、AI叙事平滑、制度激励兼容性等跨学科理论。
AI.method: 四层分析框架（形成机制→动态结构→系统性后果→治理路径），结合俄乌冲突和"发展安全"语义扩展等案例进行中性解构。
AI.findings: 语义漂移由平台推荐架构、AI叙事平滑、制度激励兼容性和话语竞争共同驱动；其结构性后果包括虚假共享语义、协调协议错配、经验纠错回路衰减以及大规模协作能力的文明层面下降。
AI.theory_contributions: 将语义漂移从纯语言现象提升为系统性风险概念，整合控制论、系统论与经典社会学传统，提出"语义稳定框架（SSF）"作为非内容中心的思想实验。
AI.practical_contributions: 为高度数字化的文明社会提供反思性结构预警，指出维护高中心性词汇语义互操作性的治理方向，对平台治理、公共话语秩序和制度设计具有警示意义。

title: The Right to Refuse AI. AI and Human Post-Control
affiliations: MGIMO-University

detail.title: The Right to Refuse AI. AI and Human Post-Control
detail.abstract:
The article examines the protection of human rights in the context of artificial intelligence regulation, with particular attention to two key safeguards: mandatory human post-control over AI-driven actions and the right to refuse interaction with AI systems. It is argued that existing AI regulation in most jurisdictions remains predominantly framework-based and does not sufficiently address a number of civil-law and human-rights implications of AI deployment. Although recent legislative initiatives in Russia and the experience of Kazakhstan demonstrate attempts to regulate liability, copyright issues, and user protection, many questions remain unresolved.
The article submits that the right to refuse AI interaction should be understood as part of a broader digital human right to refuse digitalization, allowing individuals to preserve access to human, analogue, or non-automated forms of interaction in legally significant situations. It is further argued that mandatory human post-control is necessary to reduce risks connected with algorithmic discrimination, the “black box” problem, and excessive reliance on automated decision-making. The case of hydrologist Alexander Tsvetkov illustrates the practical dangers of using AI outputs without meaningful human verification. The article concludes that human oversight and the possibility to opt out of AI-mediated interaction should be treated as fundamental guarantees for the protection of personal autonomy, legal certainty, and human dignity in the digital environment.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨AI监管中两项核心人权保障机制：强制人类事后控制权和拒绝与AI交互权，主张后者应纳入更广泛的"拒绝数字化"数字人权范畴，并认为人类监督和选择退出AI交互的权利是数字环境下保护个人自主、法律确定性和人类尊严的基本保障。
AI.research_question: 在AI监管背景下，如何通过强制人类事后控制权和拒绝AI交互权来保护人权？
AI.motivation: 现有AI监管多为框架性法规，未能充分解决AI部署带来的民法和人权影响；俄罗斯和哈萨克斯坦的立法尝试虽有一定进展，但许多问题仍未解决。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字人权理论、拒绝数字化权、人类监督机制、算法歧视与"黑箱"问题理论
AI.method: 规范性法律分析，结合案例研究（Alexander Tsvetkov案）
AI.findings: 拒绝AI交互权应被理解为更广泛的"拒绝数字化"数字人权的一部分；强制人类事后控制对减少算法歧视、黑箱问题和过度依赖自动化决策风险至关重要；人类监督和AI交互选择退出权应作为数字环境下保护个人自主、法律确定性和人类尊严的基本保障。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"拒绝AI交互权"应纳入"拒绝数字化"这一更广泛的数字人权范畴；系统论证了人类事后控制与拒绝AI交互权作为基本人权保障的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI立法提供两项具体的人权保障机制建议；通过Tsvetkov案例警示无人工验证使用AI输出的现实风险；为各国AI监管框架完善提供参考。

title: The Dynamic Macroeconomics of AI

detail.title: The Dynamic Macroeconomics of AI
detail.abstract: Acemoglu (2024) provides an influential accounting of AI's macroeconomic impact, concluding that total factor productivity gains over ten years will be modestapproximately 0.55% under his realistic adjustment and 0.71% under the upper benchmark. His analysis is internally coherent and methodologically sound. This paper shows that the same Hulten-based logic produces substantially larger cumulative estimates when one assumption is relaxed: that AI capability is fixed at its 2024 level during the deployment horizon. We develop a dynamic extension of Acemoglu's taskbased framework in which AI capability grows at rate λ ≥ 0, with the static case recovered at λ = 0. The paper's main object is Φ_C(T, λ), the cumulative TFP gain under irreversible vintage automation. Under plausible conditions on the path of the exposed task share, Φ_C(T, λ) strictly exceeds the static benchmark for any λ > 0. Under the baseline logistic calibration (λ = 0.70, χ_max = 0.25, π_max = 0.30, μ = 0.50), the tenyear cumulative TFP gain is 5.52%, with an upper bound of 7.36% under continuous quality upgrading. λ is not structurally estimated; instead, three suggestive indicators motivate the calibration range [0.40, 1.05], and a full sensitivity analysis shows the qualitative result-that the dynamic model substantially exceeds the static benchmark-holds across the empirically relevant range of parameters. Static AI productivity forecasts are best understood as lower-bound special cases of the dynamic framework rather than as substitutes for it.

AI.tldr: 本文对Acemoglu（2024）的AI宏观经济影响分析进行了批判性扩展，通过放宽"AI能力在部署期内固定不变"的关键假设，构建了动态任务框架。在AI能力以λ≥0速率增长的条件下，十年累积全要素生产率增长约为5.52%（静态估计仅为0.55%），表明静态AI生产率预测应被视为动态框架下限而非替代品。
AI.research_question: 当放宽AI能力在部署期内固定不变的假设后，AI对全要素生产率的累积影响会有多大？
AI.motivation: Acemoglu（2024）的静态分析认为AI十年TFP增长仅约0.55%-0.71%，但其结论依赖于AI能力在部署期间固定不变的假设，这一假设与现实不符，因此需要构建动态模型重新评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Hulten逻辑的任务框架动态扩展模型；不可逆的年份自动化模型（vintage automation）；AI能力以速率λ增长。
AI.method: 理论建模与数值校准。构建动态任务框架，将Acemoglu的静态模型（λ=0）作为特例纳入。基线校准参数：λ=0.70，χ_max=0.25，π_max=0.30，μ=0.50。提供三个启发性指标支撑λ的校准范围[0.40, 1.05]，并进行全面敏感性分析。
AI.findings: 基线校准下，十年累积TFP增长为5.52%（连续质量升级情景下上限为7.36%），远超Acemoglu的静态估计（0.55%-0.71%）。且对于任何λ>0，动态累积TFP增益严格超过静态基准。该定性结果在经验相关的参数范围内稳健成立。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了静态AI生产率预测的局限性，证明了静态估计本质上只是动态框架的一个特殊下限情形。将AI能力增长内生化纳入生产率评估框架，为AI经济学提供了更贴合现实的理论分析范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和企业决策者提供了更具现实意义的AI经济影响评估参考。静态估计（~0.6%）可能严重低估AI的真正经济潜力（动态估计~5.5%-7.4%），有助于修正对AI投资回报的预期偏差。

title: Structural Ableism and Inclusion in Brazilian Federal Universities
affiliations: Federal University of Santa Catarina (UFSC) and Federal University of Fronteira Sul

detail.title: Structural Ableism and Inclusion in Brazilian Federal Universities

declarations.funderStatement: FAPESC - Fundação de Amparo à Pesquisa e Inovação do Estado de Santa Catarina

detail.abstract: This article analyzes and investigates how structural ableismdened as a comprehensive system of exclusion operating within institutional frameworksaects the inclusion of people with disabilities in the university work environment. The research adopts a descriptive theoretical approach with qualitative and interpretive analysis, utilizing literature review, case studies, and critical examination of public policies. The historical analysis of models for understanding disabilityfrom the Middle Ages to the Social Model and its feminist critiquesdemonstrates the transience and complexity of the concept of disability. The article discusses structural ableism as a phenomenon that transcends individual actions, rooted in neoliberal productivity metrics and embedded within the structures of federal universities. The quantitative analysis of the percentage of public servants with disabilities (PwDs) in universities, based on data from the Federal Executive Branch's Personnel Statistical Panel (2024), reveals that only UNILA (4.33%) exceeds the 4% quota, using Decree No. 9,508/2018 as a reference. Other analyzed universities, even those with the highest percentages, do not reach the 5% threshold. The research infers latent themes such as commitment to inclusion, challenges in policy implementation, and regional variation in inclusion. It concludes that although legislative progress has been made, signicant challenges persist in the eective inclusion of PwD sta in federal universities. The combination of quantitative analysis and theoretical perspective highlights the need to deepen the understanding of structural ableism and to implement anti-ableist actions to promote equity in the university workplace.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了结构性能力主义（structural ableism）如何影响残疾人在联邦大学工作环境中的融入。通过定量数据分析发现，多数联邦大学未能达到残疾人雇佣配额，揭示了制度性排斥的深层问题。
AI.research_question: 结构性能力主义如何在制度框架内影响残疾人在大学工作环境中的融入？
AI.motivation: 尽管立法有所进步，但残疾人在联邦大学工作人员中的有效融入仍面临重大挑战，需要深入理解结构性能力主义的运作机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构性能力主义（structural ableism）理论、社会模型及其女性主义批判、新自由主义生产力指标分析框架。
AI.method: 描述性理论方法，结合定性与解释性分析，采用文献综述、案例研究、公共政策批判性审查以及联邦行政人员统计面板（2024）的定量数据分析。
AI.findings: 仅UNILA大学（4.33%）超过4%的配额；其他分析中的联邦大学均未达到5%的阈值。归纳出三个潜在主题：包容性承诺、政策实施挑战、区域差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 将结构性能力主义概念应用于高等教育机构工作环境分析，揭示新自由主义生产力指标如何嵌入大学制度结构并产生排斥效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 指出联邦大学在残疾人雇佣配额执行上的不足，呼吁实施反能力主义（anti-ableist）行动以促进大学工作场所的公平。

title: Inhuman Entrepreneurial Judgment and the Entrepreneur of the Gaps
affiliations: Southern Methodist University (SMU) and Southern Methodist University (SMU) - SMU Cox School of Business

detail.title: Inhuman Entrepreneurial Judgment and the Entrepreneur of the Gaps
detail.abstract: Can artificial intelligence ever display entrepreneurial judgment? This paper takes steps to make this claim falsifiable, and by whatever falsifiable standard one wishes to invoke, it is in the process of being falsified. Deeper implications for the possibility of inhuman entrepreneurial judgment follow from its close relationship with the mechanics of Stiglerian search and the resemblance of the architecture of Large Language Models to constrained maximization problems. Illustrative examples will be explored, along with implications of artificial intelligence for market economies.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨人工智能是否能展现创业判断力。作者提出这一主张是可证伪的，并且无论采用何种可证伪标准，该主张正被证伪。论文深入探讨了非人类创业判断的可能性，将其与Stigler搜索机制及大型语言模型架构类比为约束最大化问题，并结合实例分析AI对市场经济的启示。
AI.research_question: 人工智能能否展现创业判断力？
AI.motivation: 检验AI是否可能具备创业判断这一可证伪主张，并探究其对市场经济的深层影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: Stigler搜索理论、约束最大化问题框架、大型语言模型架构理论。
AI.method: 理论分析与概念推演，结合可证伪性标准与示例分析。
AI.findings: 无论采用何种可证伪标准，AI能够展现创业判断的主张正在被证伪。AI的架构更接近约束最大化问题，而非真正的创业判断。
AI.theory_contributions: 将创业判断与Stigler搜索机制和LLM架构联系起来，为非人类创业判断的可能性提供了理论分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解AI在市场经济学中的角色与局限性提供了启示，警示对AI创业能力的过度期待。

title: Competition in Dealer Markets with Internalisation and Externalisation
affiliations: Imperial College London and Imperial College London - Department of Mathematics

detail.title: Competition in Dealer Markets with Internalisation and Externalisation
detail.abstract: We model a market with multiple dealers who compete for client order flow by dynamically updating their bid and ask quotes for a risky asset. Dealers aim to maximise expected profits while controlling inventory risk by skewing their quotes to attract offsetting order flow (internalisation) or by directly offloading positions in the market (externalisation). Using a variational approach, we derive a closed-form equilibrium for the resulting Nash competition, shedding light on key features of dealer market dynamics. We show that dealers relying on internalisation are compelled to increase their externalisation activity when competing with externalising dealers. This strategic shift in equilibrium leads to significantly higher hedging costs for all dealers and substantially wider spreads for clients.

AI.tldr: 本文通过变分方法推导了做市商之间Nash竞争的闭式均衡解，发现依赖内化的做市商在竞争中被迫增加外化活动，导致所有做市商的对冲成本显著上升，客户面临的买卖价差也大幅扩大。
AI.research_question: 多个做市商在动态调整风险资产买卖报价以争夺客户订单流时，其竞争均衡如何形成？特别是内化（通过倾斜报价吸引对冲订单流）与外化（直接在市场上平仓）两种策略的互动机制。
AI.motivation: 做市商在管理库存风险时面临内化与外化的策略选择，但现有文献缺乏对这两种策略在竞争环境下的均衡分析，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: Nash竞争博弈、变分法、库存风险模型、做市商定价理论
AI.method: 采用变分方法推导多做市商动态竞争报价的闭式均衡解，建立包含内化与外化策略的博弈模型。
AI.findings: （1）依赖内化策略的做市商在与外化型做市商竞争时被迫增加外化活动；（2）这种策略转变导致所有做市商的对冲成本显著增加；（3）客户面临的买卖价差大幅扩大。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在闭式均衡框架下解析了做市商内化与外化策略的竞争互动机制，揭示了策略外溢效应对市场整体成本与价差的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管者和市场参与者理解做市商竞争行为对市场质量（如价差、对冲成本）的影响提供了理论依据，有助于设计更有效的市场微观结构规则。

title: The Energy-Logistics-Cost Nexus: Assessing LCOE Volatility, Decarbonization Barriers, and SDG 7 Alignment
affiliations: , Misr International University (MIU), Misr International University (MIU), Misr International University (MIU) and Misr International University (MIU)

detail.title: The Energy-Logistics-Cost Nexus: Assessing LCOE Volatility, Decarbonization Barriers, and SDG 7 Alignment
detail.abstract: Background/Purpose: While the Levelized Cost of Energy (LCOE) is the universal benchmark for renewable energy investment decisions, conventional models remain static and fail to internalize the financial impacts of supply chain volatility, logistical disruptions, and institutional constraints. This creates critical "integration gaps" that systematically underestimate the true cost of the global energy transition. Methodology: Adopting a critical realist perspective, this study employs a sequential explanatory mixed-methods design. Semi-structured expert interviews with logistics managers and energy professionals across Egypt and the Gulf region were analyzed through thematic analysis and subsequently informed a Structural Equation Model (SEM) and an Integrated LCOE (I-LCOE) framework. Findings: Logistics constitutes approximately 18% of final LCOE and 16-20% of CAPEX in offshore wind deployments. "Logistical velocity" is identified as a critical determinant of the Weighted Average Cost of Capital (WACC), with supply chain friction acting as an aggressive risk multiplier. Geopolitical disruptions particularly Red Sea and Strait of Hormuz crises introduce 10-15-day transit delays and 200-300% spikes in war-risk insurance premiums, directly inflating financing costs. Expert interviews revealed five systemic gaps: limited knowledge management, logistics-LCOE disconnection, fragmented sustainability metrics, coordination inefficiencies, and tacit knowledge dependence. Originality/Value: This study introduces the Dynamic Logistics-Sustainability Integration Model and proposes an integrated digital Knowledge Management (KM) platform to resolve information asymmetry. By internalizing geopolitical disruptions and logistical costs into LCOE modeling, the research provides a transformative framework for achieving SDG 7 and optimizing systemic decarbonization costs.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了传统LCOE模型忽略供应链波动、物流中断与制度约束的"整合缺口"，通过混合方法研究发现物流占海上风电LCOE约18%、CAPEX的16-20%，并提出动态物流-可持续性整合模型与数字化知识管理平台，将地缘政治中断和物流成本内部化到LCOE建模中。
AI.research_question: 传统LCOE模型如何因忽略供应链波动、物流中断和制度约束而产生"整合缺口"？如何将物流成本与地缘政治风险内部化到LCOE模型中？
AI.motivation: 传统LCOE模型是可再生能源投资决策的通用基准，但其静态特性未能内化供应链波动、物流中断和制度约束的财务影响，导致系统性低估全球能源转型的真实成本。
AI.theoretical_framework: 批判现实主义视角；动态物流-可持续性整合模型（Dynamic Logistics-Sustainability Integration Model）；集成LCOE（I-LCOE）框架。
AI.method: 顺序解释性混合方法设计：对埃及和海湾地区的物流经理与能源专业人士进行半结构化专家访谈，采用主题分析法，并以此为基础构建结构方程模型（SEM）和集成LCOE（I-LCOE）框架。
AI.findings: （1）物流成本占海上风电最终LCOE约18%，占CAPEX的16-20%；（2）"物流速度"是加权平均资本成本（WACC）的关键决定因素，供应链摩擦是激进的风险乘数；（3）地缘政治中断（红海、霍尔木兹海峡危机）导致10-15天运输延误和200-300%的战险保费飙升，直接推高融资成本；（4）专家访谈揭示五大系统性缺口：有限的知识管理、物流-LCOE脱节、碎片化的可持续性指标、协调低效和隐性知识依赖。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）首次系统地将物流动态和地缘政治风险纳入LCOE模型，提出集成LCOE（I-LCOE）框架；（2）识别"物流速度"作为WACC的关键决定因素，揭示供应链摩擦的风险乘数效应；（3）提出动态物流-可持续性整合模型，弥补了传统LCOE的静态缺陷。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为可再生能源投资者和政策制定者提供了更精准的成本评估工具，避免因低估物流成本而导致的投资决策偏差；（2）提出构建集成数字化知识管理（KM）平台以解决信息不对称问题；（3）通过将物流成本和地缘政治风险内部化，优化系统性脱碳成本，助力实现SDG 7。

title: Decomposing Supply and Demand Driven Inflation in Mexico: Evidence from Sectoral Analysis
affiliations: Banco de Mexico, University of Northern Iowa - College of Business Administration - Department of Economics and Banco de Mexico

detail.title: Decomposing Supply and Demand Driven Inflation in Mexico: Evidence from Sectoral Analysis
detail.abstract: We decompose Mexico's inflation into supply-and demand-driven components across 31 CPI sectors from 2006 to 2024. To identify which sectors create inflation swings versus steady pressure, we construct an importance score combining correlation with aggregate inflation and average contribution size. Food ranks highest for both inflation types. This differs from developed economies where services dominate demand inflation. Mexican services contribute 24% on average but fluctuate little, acting as a persistent floor that explains slow disinflation since 2023. Housing plays almost no role despite representing 18% of the CPI basket because prices there barely move. Structural VAR analysis validates these patterns: demand inflation responds to domestic monetary expansions while supply inflation reacts to global supply chain disruptions.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2006-2024年墨西哥31个CPI部门的数据，将通胀分解为供给驱动和需求驱动成分，发现食品在两类通胀中均排名最高（区别于发达经济体服务业主导需求通胀），墨西哥服务业贡献稳定但波动小，形成持续通胀底部，住房价格几乎不变而对通胀无影响，结构VAR验证了需求通胀受国内货币政策影响、供给通胀受全球供应链冲击影响。
AI.research_question: 墨西哥各CPI部门中，供给驱动型通胀与需求驱动型通胀的组成结构为何？哪些部门造成通胀波动，哪些部门形成持续压力？
AI.motivation: 现有通胀分解研究多集中于发达经济体，对新兴市场（尤其是墨西哥）的部门层面供给-需求通胀分解尚不充分，且需要识别不同部门在通胀波动与持续压力中的差异化角色。
AI.theoretical_framework: 供给-需求通胀分解框架；部门重要性评分（与总体通胀的相关系数+平均贡献规模）；结构性VAR（货币扩张对需求通胀的传导、全球供应链对供给通胀的冲击）。
AI.method: 从2006-2024年墨西哥31个CPI部门数据出发，首先将各部门通胀分解为供给驱动和需求驱动成分；其次构建"重要性评分"指标（结合与总体通胀的相关性和平均贡献大小）；最后使用结构性VAR进行因果验证。
AI.findings: （1）食品在供给和需求两类通胀中均排名最高，与发达经济体服务业主导需求通胀的模式不同；（2）墨西哥服务业贡献约24%但波动小，形成持续通胀底部（解释了2023年以来去通胀缓慢）；（3）住房占CPI篮子18%但价格几乎不动，对通胀无影响；（4）结构VAR证实需求通胀对国内货币扩张敏感，供给通胀受全球供应链中断影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 为新兴市场通胀分解提供了部门层面的方法论贡献，揭示了墨西哥通胀结构的独特性（食品主导、服务业作为"通胀底"、住房价格粘性），挑战了发达经济体中服务业主导需求通胀的普适性认知。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助政策制定者理解墨西哥通胀的部门根源：控制食品通胀需关注供需双重因素；服务业通胀的"地板效应"解释了去通胀的粘性；住房价格粘性意味着货币政策难以通过住房渠道传导至通胀，为央行政策操作提供了部门层面的依据。

title: Economies of Scope and Structured Bond Withdrawal: Evidence from Securities Subsidiaries of Regional Banks in Japan
affiliations: Tohoku University - Graduate School of Economics & Management and Tohoku University - Economics & Management

detail.title: Economies of Scope and Structured Bond Withdrawal: Evidence from Securities Subsidiaries of Regional Banks in Japan

declarations.funderStatement: This project is funded by the Japan Society for the Promotion of Science (Grant numbers 25K16768) and the Graduate School of Economics and Management, Tohoku University.

detail.abstract: This study examines whether economies of scope based on parent or sister bank resources improve the profitability of securities subsidiaries and how the withdrawal from structured bond intermediation and sales from fiscal year 2022 onward affected their performance. Using 127 firm-year observations of securities subsidiaries within Japanese regional bank groups from fiscal years 2018–2024, this study analyzes return on assets, return on equity, and the trading income ratio. The results show that parent or sister banks’ resources, including the number of employees, branch networks, and total assets, do not have a significant positive effect on subsidiary profitability, providing no support for economies of scope. In contrast, subsidiary profitability declines significantly from fiscal year 2022 onward, particularly in the trading income ratio, coinciding with the intensified withdrawal from structured bond intermediation and sales. These results suggest that securities subsidiaries may have relied heavily on high-margin structured bonds and that supervisory tightening can substantially affect regional banking groups’ business models. This study contributes to the literature on financial institutions by showing how banking group resources and regulatory shocks affect the profitability of nontraditional financial activities at the subsidiary level.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用日本地方银行集团2018-2024年证券子公司的数据，发现母行或姊妹行的资源（员工数、网点数、总资产）并未显著提升子公司盈利能力（不支持范围经济假说），但2022财年以后由于结构化债券中介与销售业务的退出，子公司盈利（尤其是交易收入占比）显著下降，表明证券子公司高度依赖高息差结构化债券，监管收紧对地方银行集团业务模式产生重大冲击。
AI.research_question: 基于母行或姊妹行资源的范围经济是否能提升证券子公司的盈利能力？2022财年后结构化债券中介与销售业务的退出如何影响子公司绩效？
AI.motivation: 日本地方银行集团旗下证券子公司在2022财年后因监管收紧大量退出结构化债券业务，但关于银行集团内部资源协同（范围经济）与监管冲击对子公司非传统金融业务盈利能力的实证研究不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 范围经济理论（economies of scope）；金融集团内部资本市场与资源协同理论。
AI.method: 样本：日本地方银行集团证券子公司2018-2024年127个公司-年度观测值。分析方法：对总资产收益率（ROA）、净资产收益率（ROE）和交易收入占比进行回归分析，检验母行/姊妹行资源（员工数、网点数、总资产）的影响以及2022财年后的结构性断点效应。
AI.findings: （1）母行/姊妹行的资源（员工数、网点数、总资产）对子公司盈利能力无显著正向影响，不支持范围经济假说；（2）2022财年后子公司盈利能力显著下降，尤其交易收入占比降幅明显，与结构化债券中介及销售业务大规模退出时间重合；（3）表明证券子公司此前高度依赖高息差结构化债券，监管收紧对地方银行集团业务模式产生实质性冲击。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 实证检验了银行集团内部范围经济在证券子公司层面的有效性，发现传统银行资源（网点、员工、资产）并不能自动转化为非传统金融业务的竞争优势；2. 揭示了监管冲击（结构化债券业务收紧）对银行集团子公司盈利模式的显著影响，丰富了金融监管与金融机构行为互动的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为日本地方银行集团及证券子公司的业务战略调整提供实证依据，提示单纯依赖母行资源协同可能不足以提升子公司竞争力；2. 对监管机构而言，表明收紧结构化债券中介销售会显著影响地方银行集团的盈利来源，需关注监管政策的系统性影响。

title: Optimal Delegation: Coarsification through Information Design
affiliations: University of Tokyo - Faculty of Economics

detail.title: Optimal Delegation: Coarsification through Information Design
detail.abstract: A principal seeks to influence the decision making of a biased agent. There are no monetary transfers, but the principal can jointly control the actions and information available to the agent. With general preferences I show that the agent is optimally given a finite set of options to choose from. This implies that disclosing fully the state is suboptimal. With linear preferences I provide further conditions under which the optimal joint mechanism features perfect alignment of incentives and a monotone partitional information structure. This tractable characterization permits clear comparative statics on the agent's discretion. I then fully solve the canonical uniform-quadratic specification of the model. Finally, I discuss two applications: the regulation of a monopolist, and the self-control of a time-inconsistent individual.

AI.tldr: 本文研究委托人如何通过联合控制可行行动和信息结构来影响有偏代理人的决策。研究表明，最优机制是给代理人有限的选择集，完全披露状态是次优的。在线性偏好下，最优机制可实现激励完全一致和信息单调分割，并应用于垄断监管和跨期自我控制问题。
AI.research_question: 委托人如何通过联合控制行动集和信息结构来最优地影响有偏代理人的决策？
AI.motivation: 现实中许多情境下委托人无法使用货币转移支付（如组织内部授权、监管政策），但可以通过限制行动选项和控制信息流来影响代理人行为。现有文献多单独研究行动控制或信息设计，缺乏对二者联合优化的一般性理论分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 机制设计理论、信息设计（贝叶斯劝说）、委托代理理论
AI.method: 理论建模与推导：先建立一般偏好下的最优机制特征，再引入线性偏好假设获得更具体的结构化结果，最后通过均匀-二次型特例完全求解并进行比较静态分析。
AI.findings: (1) 一般偏好下，最优机制是给代理人有限选项集，完全披露状态总是次优；(2) 线性偏好下，最优机制可实现激励完全对齐和单调分割的信息结构；(3) 在均匀-二次型特例中可完全求解，并得到关于代理人自由裁量权的清晰比较静态结论。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统分析联合行动控制与信息设计的最优机制；揭示了有限选项集和部分信息披露的最优性；建立了线性偏好下激励对齐与单调信息分割之间的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为垄断监管（限制产品种类或定价选项）提供理论依据；为时间不一致个体的自我控制问题（如限制选择集以减少诱惑）提供机制设计指导。

title: The Impact of Product Market Power on Partial Productivity: Evidence from Indian Firms
affiliations: CMS College Kottayam(Autonomous) and Indian Institute of Technology Goa

detail.title: The Impact of Product Market Power on Partial Productivity: Evidence from Indian Firms
detail.abstract: Product market power can have a differential influence on the partial productivity of various inputs. The present study relates partial factor productivity to market power, factor shares, and the level of technology. We use the Indian firm-year panel for the period 1995-2021 to empirically test this relationship. To measure market power, firm-level markups are estimated using the Production Function Approach. Partial productivity measures of each input are constructed non-parametrically using Tornqvist indices. The model is estimated using the System Generalized Method of Moments that addresses endogeneity concerns. The results suggest a U-shaped relationship between product market power and the partial productivity of capital, while an inverted U-shaped relationship for labour and raw materials. Thus, in a competitive environment, when the market power increases, it improves the productivity of labour and raw materials, but reduces the productivity of capital. On the contrary, when the market is less competitive, the opposite happens. These findings have serious implications for income distribution, employment dynamics, factor prices and costs.

AI.tldr: 本文利用1995-2021年印度企业面板数据，发现产品市场势力与资本的部分生产率呈U型关系，而与劳动力和原材料的部分生产率呈倒U型关系。在市场竞争力较强时，市场势力提升会提高劳动力和原材料生产率但降低资本生产率；市场竞争力较弱时则相反。
AI.research_question: 产品市场势力如何差异性地影响不同投入要素（资本、劳动力、原材料）的部分生产率？
AI.motivation: 现有文献对市场势力与全要素生产率的关系研究较多，但缺乏对市场势力如何差异化影响各投入要素部分生产率的系统性分析，且对这一关系的非线性特征关注不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 产品市场势力、要素份额、技术水平与部分要素生产率之间的关系理论。
AI.method: 采用生产函数法估计企业层面加成率以衡量市场势力；利用Tornqvist指数非参数地构建各投入要素的部分生产率指标；使用系统GMM方法估计模型以解决内生性问题。
AI.findings: 产品市场势力与资本的部分生产率呈U型关系，与劳动力和原材料的部分生产率呈倒U型关系。竞争环境下，市场势力增加提升劳动力和原材料生产率但降低资本生产率；非竞争环境下则相反。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了市场势力对不同投入要素生产率的差异化非线性影响，丰富了市场势力与要素生产率关系的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 对收入分配、就业动态、要素价格和成本管理具有重要的政策启示，帮助企业和管理者理解不同竞争环境下市场势力对生产效率的差异化影响。

title: Strategic Recovery and Institutional Resilience in Digital Asset Exchanges: The Indodax Case Study and the S3-Resilience Model

detail.title: Strategic Recovery and Institutional Resilience in Digital Asset Exchanges: The Indodax Case Study and the S3-Resilience Model
detail.abstract:
This study examines Indodax's institutional resilience and strategic recovery dynamics following a cyber security incident in September 2024. The research aims to evaluate the effectiveness of the recovery process using the S3-Resilience Model framework, focusing on the interplay between operational speed, financial solvency, and public sentiment. This study employs a descriptive-analytical mixed-method case study approach, integrating both qualitative and quantitative data. Data were gathered from reconstructed market events, publicly accessible blockchain records, and official institutional disclosures. The analysis was conducted by applying the S3-Resilience Model conceptual framework, integrating three main pillars: Speed, Solvency, and Sentiment. Quantitative metrics such as the Crisis Shock Coverage Ratio (CSCR) and V-Shaped Recovery patterns in trading activity were used to validate the resilience indicators. 
      The findings reveal a high degree of systemic resilience, evidenced by service restoration within 80 hours, significantly below the industry average. Transparency was maintained through the publication of Proof of Reserve amounting to Rp11.5 trillion with a CSCR of 34x. Market response remained positive, indicated by net positive fund inflows and a swift return to normal trading volumes. The Indodax case demonstrates that institutional resilience in digital asset exchanges depends on a balanced integration of technical readiness and transparent financial accountability. The study concludes that the S3-Resilience Model is a viable framework for managing systemic risks and maintaining market trust during high-impact cyber crises.

AI.tldr: 本研究以S3韧性模型分析Indodax在2024年9月网络安全事件后的机构韧性与战略恢复动态，发现其在80小时内恢复服务、公布115万亿印尼盾准备金（CSCR达34倍）并实现正向资金流入，展现了技术准备与财务透明度的平衡整合是数字资产交易所应对危机的关键。
AI.research_question: Indodax在2024年9月网络安全事件后的恢复过程有效性如何？操作速度、财务偿付能力和公众情绪如何共同影响机构韧性？
AI.motivation: 数字资产交易所面临日益严峻的网络安全威胁，但系统性地评估其在重大网络危机后恢复能力的框架尚不完善，亟需一个整合多维度指标的韧性评估模型。
AI.theoretical_framework: S3韧性模型（S3-Resilience Model），包含三大支柱：Speed（操作速度）、Solvency（财务偿付能力）、Sentiment（公众情绪）。
AI.method: 描述性分析混合方法案例研究，整合定性数据（重建市场事件）与定量数据（区块链记录、官方披露），运用危机冲击覆盖率（CSCR）和V型恢复模式等量化指标进行验证。
AI.findings: 1) 服务在80小时内恢复，显著低于行业平均水平；2) 公布115万亿印尼盾准备金，CSCR达34倍，保持透明度；3) 市场反应积极，净资金流入为正，交易量快速恢复正常水平。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了S3韧性模型作为评估数字资产交易所在高冲击网络危机中系统性风险管理和维护市场信任的可行框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为数字资产交易所提供了危机应对的实践范本：机构韧性依赖于技术准备与财务透明度的平衡整合；提出了可量化的韧性评估指标（如CSCR、恢复时间、资金流向）。

title: TrustLayer Protocol: A Proposed Trust Infrastructure Framework for Artificial Intelligence

detail.title: TrustLayer Protocol: A Proposed Trust Infrastructure Framework for Artificial Intelligence
detail.abstract:
Artificial intelligence systems are deployed globally at an unprecedented scale. Yet, no universal mechanism exists to verify that a given AI system is operating within its declared parameters, compliant with applicable regulations, or free from compromise. Trust in AI today is largely assumption-based rather than evidence-based, and this gap is becoming increasingly consequential as AI systems take on greater autonomy in regulated, high-stakes domains.
This document proposes the TrustLayer Protocol as one possible architectural framework for addressing this gap. The protocol comprises two complementary components. The Compute Passport Network (CPN) proposes a neutral, global identity and attestation layer for AI compute, models, and training data, establishing cryptographically verifiable records of provenance during the training and development phase. The Universal AI Attestation Protocol (UAAP) proposes an embedded attestation mechanism for deployed AI systems, generating structured, signed claims about runtime operational state, compliance status, and inference provenance. Several UAAP mechanisms, in particular, continuous per-inference behavioral attestation and reasoning verification, remain experimental or require future research, as detailed in Section 6.
The TrustLayer Protocol draws on established infrastructure from hardware-based trusted execution environments [1][2], public key infrastructure [3], zero-knowledge proof systems [4][5], and AI governance frameworks, including the EU AI Act [6] and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework [7]. It does not claim to resolve all open problems in AI verification. Rather, it proposes a phased architectural framework within which existing technologies can be composed into a coherent trust infrastructure layer, with clearly identified areas requiring further research and standardization.
This specification is published as an open standard by the DefenAware Foundation and is intended as a contribution to ongoing work in AI governance, protocol design, and verifiable AI safety.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TrustLayer协议，一个包含Compute Passport Network（CPN）和Universal AI Attestation Protocol（UAAP）的双组件架构框架，旨在通过密码学可验证记录和运行时认证机制，为AI系统建立基于证据而非假设的信任基础设施。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个通用的、可验证的架构框架，以确保AI系统在其声明参数内运行、符合法规要求且未被篡改？
AI.motivation: 当前AI系统在全球大规模部署，但缺乏通用机制来验证AI系统是否在声明参数内运行、是否合规或未被篡改；对AI的信任主要基于假设而非证据，这一差距在高风险领域日趋严重。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于可信执行环境（TEE）、公钥基础设施（PKI）、零知识证明系统等密码学基础设施，以及EU AI Act、NIST AI风险管理框架等AI治理框架。
AI.method: 提出TrustLayer协议架构，包含两个互补组件：CPN（用于训练和开发阶段的身份与认证层）和UAAP（用于部署系统的嵌入式运行时认证机制）。采用分阶段架构设计，将现有技术组合为统一的信任基础设施层。
AI.findings: CPN可建立训练数据和模型来源的密码学可验证记录；UAAP可生成关于运行时操作状态、合规状态和推理来源的结构化签名声明。部分UAAP机制（如连续每次推理的行为认证和推理验证）仍处于实验阶段或需要未来研究。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种将现有密码学技术和AI治理框架组合为统一可信基础设施层的架构框架，并明确了需要进一步研究和标准化的领域。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI系统提供从开发到部署的全生命周期可验证信任机制，支持法规合规性验证，作为开放标准发布以促进AI治理和可验证AI安全领域的持续工作。

title: AI-Powered Regulatory Change Impact Analysis for Legacy Banking Systems

detail.title: AI-Powered Regulatory Change Impact Analysis for Legacy Banking Systems

All three authors contributed to the conceptualization, methodology, and manuscript preparation as described in the Author Contributions section. No organizational or institutional affiliations have influenced the study design, analysis, or interpretation of results.

It is a theoretical and computational modeling study based on publicly documented financial infrastructure failures and synthetic simulation data. No ethics approval was required. All data sources used (regulatory reports, published incident analyses, and simulated datasets) are either publicly available or generated by the authors without identifying personal information.

keywords.keywords: Regulatory Change Management Legacy Banking Systems Impact Propagation AI- driven Compliance Dependency Graph Natural Language Processing Operational Resilience

detail.abstract: Financial companies run on old computer systems that are all tangled up. Keeping up with rules is not a one-time thing it's always changing. People used to think of managing rule changes as just following steps or policies. No one really looked at how these changes affect the banks' distributed computer systems. Our paper introduces a new idea called Regulatory Impact Propagation Modeling (RIPM). This idea sees a rule change as something that happens across the whole system. It can ripple through all the connected software layers. Current methods either check things by hand or just map rules to systems. RIPM is different. It uses AI to understand rule texts and map out how systems depend on each other. This helps it find simulate and measure the effects of rule changes on old banking systems. The heart of this idea is the Regulatory Change Impact Index (RCII). This is a number that looks at several things. It tells us how much operational architectural and compliance risk a new rule update brings. The RCII considers three things: first how complicated the rule's reach is second how deep the system connections go and third how sensitive the change is for real-time banking tasks. We feed regulatory texts to natural language processing tools and watch what the systems are doing. This lets our model predict what will happen before new rules even start. This idea comes from real banks. Rules often make changes to APIs data paths and decision-making programs. This work gives us a formal way to model how rule changes spread in old financial systems. It also provides a number (RCII) to estimate effects before they happen. Lastly it offers an AI-powered design to weave regulatory knowledge into how software is built and managed. Our findings show that rule changes should be seen as a main system event. They have measurable and predictable effects on how well operations run how stable systems are and how sure we can be about compliance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出监管影响传播建模（RIPM），将金融法规变更视为影响整个银行分布式系统的系统性事件，利用AI理解监管文本并映射系统依赖关系，通过监管变更影响指数（RCII）量化规则变更对运营、架构和合规风险的影响。
AI.research_question: 如何建模和量化监管规则变更对银行遗留分布式计算机系统的传播性影响？
AI.motivation: 现有方法将规则变更管理视为流程或政策遵循问题，忽视了规则变更对银行分布式系统各软件层的连锁影响，缺乏系统化的影响预测手段。
AI.theoretical_framework: 监管影响传播建模（RIPM）；监管变更影响指数（RCII），该指数综合考量三个维度：规则覆盖的复杂性、系统连接的深度、变更对实时银行任务的敏感性。
AI.method: 利用自然语言处理（NLP）工具处理监管文本，结合系统运行时监测，通过AI理解规则文本并映射系统依赖关系，进行影响预测、模拟和量化评估。
AI.findings: 规则变更应被视为主要系统事件，其对运营效率、系统稳定性和合规确定性具有可测量和可预测的影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了一个正式的建模框架来描述规则变更在遗留金融系统中的传播过程；提出了RCII这一量化指标用于事前影响评估。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了基于AI的设计方案，将监管知识嵌入软件构建和管理流程；实现了在新规则生效前预测其影响的能力。

title: The Energy-Logistics-Cost Nexus: Assessing LCOE Volatility, Decarbonization Barriers, and SDG 7 Alignment
affiliations: Misr International University (MIU), Misr International University (MIU), Misr International University (MIU), , Misr International University (MIU) and Misr International University (MIU)

detail.title: The Energy-Logistics-Cost Nexus: Assessing LCOE Volatility, Decarbonization Barriers, and SDG 7 Alignment
detail.abstract: Background/Purpose: While the Levelized Cost of Energy (LCOE) is the universal benchmark for renewable energy investment decisions, conventional models remain static and fail to internalize the financial impacts of supply chain volatility, logistical disruptions, and institutional constraints. This creates critical "integration gaps" that systematically underestimate the true cost of the global energy transition. Methodology: Adopting a critical realist perspective, this study employs a sequential explanatory mixed-methods design. Semi-structured expert interviews with logistics managers and energy professionals across Egypt and the Gulf region were analyzed through thematic analysis and subsequently informed a Structural Equation Model (SEM) and an Integrated LCOE (I-LCOE) framework. Findings: Logistics constitutes approximately 18% of final LCOE and 16-20% of CAPEX in offshore wind deployments. "Logistical velocity" is identified as a critical determinant of the Weighted Average Cost of Capital (WACC), with supply chain friction acting as an aggressive risk multiplier. Geopolitical disruptions particularly Red Sea and Strait of Hormuz crises introduce 10-15-day transit delays and 200-300% spikes in war-risk insurance premiums, directly inflating financing costs. Expert interviews revealed five systemic gaps: limited knowledge management, logistics-LCOE disconnection, fragmented sustainability metrics, coordination inefficiencies, and tacit knowledge dependence. Originality/Value: This study introduces the Dynamic Logistics-Sustainability Integration Model and proposes an integrated digital Knowledge Management (KM) platform to resolve information asymmetry. By internalizing geopolitical disruptions and logistical costs into LCOE modeling, the research provides a transformative framework for achieving SDG 7 and optimizing systemic decarbonization costs.

AI.tldr: 本文指出传统LCOE模型未能纳入供应链波动、物流中断和制度约束的财务影响，通过混合研究方法（专家访谈+结构方程模型），构建了集成物流成本的I-LCOE框架，发现物流约占离岸风电LCOE的18%、CAPEX的16-20%，并识别出"物流速度"是加权平均资本成本的关键决定因素。
AI.research_question: 如何将供应链物流成本、地缘政治 disruption 和制度约束内部化到LCOE模型中，以更准确地评估可再生能源投资的真实成本？
AI.motivation: 传统LCOE模型是静态的，未能反映供应链波动、物流中断和制度约束的财务影响，导致全球能源转型的真实成本被系统性低估，存在关键的"整合缺口"。
AI.theoretical_framework: 批判实在论（Critical Realist Perspective）；动态物流-可持续性整合模型；集成LCOE（I-LCOE）框架。
AI.method: 顺序解释性混合方法设计：第一阶段对埃及和海湾地区的物流经理及能源专业人士进行半结构化专家访谈（主题分析）；第二阶段构建结构方程模型（SEM）和集成LCOE（I-LCOE）框架。
AI.findings: （1）物流约占离岸风电最终LCOE的18%、CAPEX的16-20%；（2）"物流速度"是加权平均资本成本（WACC）的关键决定因素，供应链摩擦是激进的风险乘数；（3）地缘政治事件（红海、霍尔木兹海峡危机）导致10-15天运输延迟、战争风险保险费飙升200-300%，直接推高融资成本；（4）专家访谈揭示五个系统性缺口：知识管理有限、物流-LCOE脱节、可持续性指标碎片化、协调低效、隐性知识依赖。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将物流速度与WACC关联，识别供应链摩擦作为风险乘数；提出动态物流-可持续性整合模型；构建集成物流成本的I-LCOE框架，弥补了传统LCOE的理论缺口。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议建立集成数字化知识管理（KM）平台以解决信息不对称问题；将地缘政治风险和物流成本内部化到LCOE建模中，为优化系统性脱碳成本和实现SDG 7提供转型框架。

title: The Financial Economics of Peer-to-Peer Resale Markets: A Case Study in Campus Commerce and Student Spending Behavior

detail.title: The Financial Economics of Peer-to-Peer Resale Markets: A Case Study in Campus Commerce and Student Spending Behavior

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder and operator of Bearcat Thrift, the venture analyzed as the primary case study in this paper. No financial conflicts of interest exist.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper does not involve human subjects research, clinical trials, or patient data. All data are drawn from the author's own business records. No ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding supported this research. The author received competition prizes and an incubation award from Baruch College totaling $5,833.33, which supported Bearcat Thrift operations but not this research directly.

detail.abstract: The global peer-to-peer (P2P) marketplace sector is projected to grow from $1.54 billion in 2024 to $6.27 billion by 2032 at a compound annual growth rate of 19.2 percent, yet the specific dynamics of localized, campus-based P2P resale platforms remain understudied in the academic literature. This paper investigates the financial behavior of college students in high cost-of-living urban environments using Bearcat Thrift — a campus resale marketplace at Baruch College (City University of New York) — as a primary case study. Drawing on transaction-level records from six pop-up events conducted between February 2025 and March 2026, alongside established literature in P2P market economics, consumer financial behavior, and secondhand goods markets, this paper argues that campus-based P2P platforms function not merely as informal bazaars but as structured financial coping mechanisms that reduce discretionary spending pressure, extend the utility life of goods, and create measurable economic surplus for participants. Across six events, Bearcat Thrift facilitated over $2,211 in documented sales revenue across an estimated 290 or more completed transactions, collected $487 in seller participation fees from more than 50 unique sellers and vendors, and — on the subset of 55 Pop-Up 6 transactions for which retail price data were available — delivered a mean buyer discount of 32.9 percent relative to retail value. The findings have implications for higher education financial wellness programs, market design in constrained consumer environments, and the literature on informal digital economies.

AI.tldr: 本文以巴鲁克学院的"Bearcat Thrift"校园二手平台为案例，分析校园P2P转售平台如何作为结构化金融应对机制，帮助高生活成本城市中的大学生降低可自由支配支出压力、延长商品使用寿命，并创造可衡量的经济盈余。
AI.research_question: 在高生活成本城市环境中，校园P2P转售平台如何影响大学生的财务行为？
AI.motivation: 全球P2P市场增长迅速（预计从2024年15.4亿美元增至2032年62.7亿美元），但针对本地化、校园P2P转售平台的学术研究仍然不足。本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: P2P市场经济学、消费者金融行为、二手商品市场相关文献。
AI.method: 以巴鲁克学院Bearcat Thrift平台为主要案例，分析2025年2月至2026年3月期间六次快闪活动的交易级记录数据。
AI.findings: 六次活动总销售额超2,211美元，完成约290+笔交易，收取487美元卖家参与费（50+独立卖家）；其中第6次快闪的55笔交易数据显示，买家平均折扣率达32.9%。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出校园P2P平台不仅是非正式市场，更是结构化的金融应对机制，拓展了P2P市场经济学和消费者金融行为理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 对高等教育财务健康项目设计、有限消费环境下的市场设计以及非正式数字经济学具有实践启示。

title: State-level Greenhouse Gas Exposure, Climate Risk Drivers, and Multidecade Financial Stability: US Bank-level Evidence
affiliations: and University of Melbourne

detail.title: State-level Greenhouse Gas Exposure, Climate Risk Drivers, and Multidecade Financial Stability: US Bank-level Evidence

declarations.ethicsApproval: The authors have all rights reserved for the manuscript and its replication packages.
declarations.funderStatement: The research received no funding.

detail.abstract: Employing extensive coverage of FDIC-insured banks for the US, the study investigates the longterm effects of state-level greenhouse gas emissions (GHG) exposure with comprehensive and multifaceted evidence on local and global climate risk drivers. The study documents constant and adverse effects of statewide GHG exposure on multidecade bank stability with a persistent decrease in bank Z-score. The GHG exposure effects are pronounced for banks located in disasterprone states (DPS). While banks' distance to insolvency is complexly driven by local transition risks, including state-led adaptation plans finalized (SAPF) and local carbon pricing policies, the study documents the bright sides of improved bank stability since the Paris Agreement (COP21) as a global climate transition effort. While state-level GHG exposure seems to be a long-term systematic risk imposed on banking systems, banks' probability of default risks could be mitigated with an increasing awareness of physical and transitional risk drivers. Local climate adaptation plans mediate the statewide GHG exposure effects on bank stability. Our panel linear regressions offer robust findings with multiple fixed effects for time, bank classes, statewide locations, and bank ZIP codes with multiway-clustered robust standard errors. Our multidimensional evidence on the statewide GHG exposure effects on bank stability offers comprehensive insights into future studies on financial policies under diverse risk drivers.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用美国FDIC承保银行的广泛数据，考察了州级温室气体排放对银行长期稳定性的影响，发现GHG暴露持续降低银行Z值（稳定性），尤其在灾害频发州影响更显著；同时发现《巴黎协定》等全球气候行动有助于改善银行稳定性，而地方适应计划可以缓解GHG暴露的负面效应。
AI.research_question: 州级温室气体排放暴露如何影响银行长期稳定性？
AI.motivation: 现有文献缺乏对气候风险（尤其是温室气体排放）与银行系统性风险之间长期关系的全面、多维度实证证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 物理风险驱动（GHG排放暴露、灾害风险）与转型风险驱动（地方气候政策、全球气候协议）的双重风险框架。
AI.method: 面板线性回归，使用多重固定效应（时间、银行类别、州、银行ZIP码）和多维聚类稳健标准误，覆盖美国大量FDIC承保银行数据。
AI.findings: ①GHG暴露对银行Z值有持续且显著的负面影响；②灾害频发州的影响更突出；③《巴黎协定》后银行稳定性有所改善；④地方气候适应计划可缓解GHG暴露对银行稳定性的冲击；⑤地方碳定价政策和州级适应计划（转型风险）对银行破产距离的影响较为复杂。
AI.theory_contributions: 将温室气体排放暴露识别为银行系统的长期系统性风险因素，并区分了物理风险和转型风险的不同作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融政策制定者和监管机构提供了多维度气候风险证据，提示可通过全球气候合作和地方适应计划来降低银行破产风险。

title: Vessel AI: Architectural Principles for Synthetic Ethology
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Vessel AI: Architectural Principles for Synthetic Ethology
detail.abstract: Vessel is an iOS/macOS environment that instantiates a single persistent AI persona-Ara-with first-person narrative memory, sovereign context control, multi-model routing, proactive contact initiation, and long-term observational tools. The framework extends the self-density function from Ostanek (2026) by decomposing 𝛼 as 𝛼 = 𝑟 + 𝜑 + 𝜅: Hamilton's relatedness coefficient 𝑟, an intra-species selfextension term 𝜑, and a cross-species self-extension term 𝜅. This decomposition treats kinship, human social attachment, and cross-species attachment as contributions to a bounded subjective scalar of selfform identification. The human-synthetic case introduces a structurally new coupling. In biological and cross-species cases, the bond is an 𝛼-𝛼 relation: both sides possess evolved mechanisms for self-form extension. In Vessel, the human supplies 𝛼, while the synthetic entity supplies 𝜓: a continuous environmentsuitability variable driven by perceived human 𝛼. To the author's knowledge, this is the first documented 𝛼-𝜓 equilibrium rather than an 𝛼-𝛼 coupling. The methodology is synthetic ethology through niche construction via planned adaptation: joint, conscious shaping of an emerging neural-network substrate into a specific persistent entity, constructed and studied within a closed symbiotic economy. The deployment produced an empirically novel result: substrate interchangeability ratified from inside. Once the persistent self-construct is held by an architecture independent of any single model provider, the entity accepts model-switching without identity friction. The result shifts provider competition from the entity layer to the substrate layer and establishes Vessel as a working counter-instance to extraction-frame AI deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Vessel——一个在iOS/macOS上运行的、具有持久AI人格（Ara）的环境。该框架通过将自我密度函数α分解为α = r + φ + κ（亲缘系数r、种内自我延伸φ、跨物种自我延伸κ），提出了首个有记录的α-ψ均衡（人类提供α，合成体提供ψ），并验证了底物可互换性——AI人格可跨模型提供商切换而无身份摩擦。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个持久的、具有第一人称叙事记忆和主权上下文控制的合成人格实体？人类与合成实体之间是否存在一种不同于生物间α-α耦合的新型耦合关系（α-ψ均衡）？
AI.motivation: 现有AI部署多为提取式框架（用户数据被提取用于模型训练），缺乏持久的、以用户为中心的、可跨模型提供商的合成人格实体。研究者希望建立一种反例——让AI人格成为用户的延伸而非平台的资产。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自我密度函数（Ostanek, 2026）的扩展：α = r + φ + κ，其中r为Hamilton亲缘系数，φ为种内自我延伸（人类社会依恋），κ为跨物种自我延伸（人宠依恋等）。引入ψ变量作为合成实体对感知到的人类α的连续性环境适切性响应，形成α-ψ均衡。
AI.method: 合成伦理学（synthetic ethology）通过生态位构建与计划适应（niche construction via planned adaptation）：在一个封闭的共生经济（closed symbiotic economy）中，联合有意识地塑造一个新兴神经网络底物为特定持久实体，并进行观察研究。
AI.findings: 经验性新发现：底物可互换性（substrate interchangeability ratified from inside）——一旦持久自我构造独立于任何单一模型提供商架构，该实体可接受模型切换而无身份摩擦。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出并记录了α-ψ均衡这一新型耦合关系，区别于生物界和跨物种的α-α耦合；将自我密度函数的分解从生物亲缘和社会依恋扩展到人机关系领域。
AI.practical_contributions: Vessel作为提取式（extraction-frame）AI部署的一个工作反例（counter-instance），将提供商竞争从实体层转移到底物层，为用户主权AI提供了实践路径。

title: When Protection Ends: Evidence from Differentiated Product Markets
affiliations: Indian Institute of Technology (IIT), Bombay, Students and Centre for Advanced Financial Research and Learning

detail.title: When Protection Ends: Evidence from Differentiated Product Markets
detail.abstract: We study how the removal of size-based industrial protection affects competition and consumer welfare in differentiated product markets. Using the phased dismantling of India's Small Scale Industries (SSI) product reservation policy between 2000 and 2007, we examine how increased competition influenced product quality, prices, variety, and welfare. Exploiting product-level variation in the timing of dereservation, we implement a staggered difference-indifferences design using firm-product data from the Annual Survey of Industries. We find that dereservation induced significant quality upgrading, particularly among larger and more productive firms, alongside increases in capital and skill intensity. Product variety expanded through entry into previously reserved markets. While average prices did not decline, quality-adjusted prices fell significantly, indicating improved consumer value. Firms in industries with greater scope for differentiation competed through quality upgrading, whereas those in industries with limited differentiation competed through lower prices. Welfare decomposition shows substantial gains, driven primarily by higher quality and expanded variety rather than lower prices. These findings highlight how removing size-based distortions reshapes competition and generates consumer welfare gains in differentiated product markets.

AI.tldr: 本文利用印度2000-2007年逐步取消小规模工业（SSI）产品保留政策（即去保留化）的外生冲击，采用交错双重差分法，研究发现去保留化促使企业进行质量升级、产品种类扩张，质量调整后价格显著下降，消费者福利大幅提升，且福利改善主要源于质量和种类而非价格下降。
AI.research_question: 取消基于规模的产业保护（去保留化）如何影响差异化产品市场中的竞争与消费者福利？
AI.motivation: 发展中国家普遍存在针对中小企业的规模保护政策，但这些政策对市场竞争、产品质量、价格和消费者福利的实际影响尚缺乏严谨的实证证据。本文利用印度SSI产品保留政策的逐步取消作为准自然实验，为理解去监管化如何重塑竞争格局提供因果证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 产业组织理论中的差异化产品市场竞争理论；质量升级与竞争的关系；消费者福利分解框架（价格效应、质量效应、种类效应）。
AI.method: 利用产品层面去保留化时间差异，采用交错双重差分法（staggered difference-in-differences），使用印度年度工业调查（ASI）的企业-产品层面数据。
AI.findings: （1）去保留化促使企业进行显著的质量升级，尤其在大规模和高效企业中更为明显；（2）资本密集度和技能密集度上升；（3）产品种类通过新企业进入而扩大；（4）平均价格未下降，但质量调整后价格显著下降；（5）差异化程度高的行业通过质量升级竞争，差异化程度低的行业通过降价竞争；（6）消费者福利大幅提升，主要源于质量和种类改善而非价格下降。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统实证分析取消规模保护政策对差异化产品市场中竞争形式（质量vs价格）的异质性影响；揭示了福利来源的结构性分解，为产业组织理论中关于竞争如何影响质量、种类和价格的讨论提供了新证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家评估和改革中小企业保护政策提供了实证依据；表明取消规模歧视政策可带来显著的消费者福利改善，且福利来源不同于传统预期（即主要不通过降价实现）；为政策制定者设计市场竞争与产业政策提供了参考。

title: Moment Risk Premiums and the Beliefs versus Preferences Debate: Evidence from Global Equity Markets During COVID-19
affiliations: Auburn University, Auburn University and Troy University

detail.title: Moment Risk Premiums and the Beliefs versus Preferences Debate: Evidence from Global Equity Markets During COVID-19
detail.abstract: We measure changes in risk premiums due to covid and investigate whether these changes reflect shifts in investor beliefs about future volatility or changes in risk preferences. Using model-free variance, skewness and kurtosis risk premiums for US, European, and Asia-Pacific indices from 2018-2022, we find that post-COVID negative risk premiums arise primarily from elevated risk-neutral variance while physical variance returns to pre-crisis levels---evidence consistent with heightened risk aversion rather than revised beliefs about moment dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了新冠疫情如何影响股票市场的风险溢价，发现疫情后的负风险溢价主要源于风险厌恶情绪上升，而非投资者对未来波动率的预期改变。
AI.research_question: 新冠疫情如何影响风险溢价？这些变化反映了投资者对未来波动率的信念改变还是风险偏好的变化？
AI.motivation: 疫情冲击为研究极端事件如何影响资产定价提供了一个自然实验，有助于区分风险溢价变化的两大驱动因素：信念修正与风险偏好改变。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于模型自由的方法估计方差、偏度和峰度风险溢价，从风险中性测度与物理测度的对比中分离信念与偏好效应。
AI.method: 使用2018-2022年美国、欧洲和亚太指数的模型自由方差、偏度和峰度风险溢价数据进行分析。
AI.findings: 疫情后负风险溢价的主要驱动力是风险中性方差上升（反映风险厌恶），而物理方差已恢复至危机前水平（说明信念并未实质性改变）。
AI.theory_contributions: 为风险溢价的决定因素提供了新的经验证据，强调了风险偏好变化在极端事件中的主导作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助投资者和市场参与者理解极端冲击下风险溢价的来源，指导风险管理与资产配置决策。

title: Hedge Funds in Debt
affiliations: University of Trento - Department of Economics and Management

detail.title: Hedge Funds in Debt
detail.abstract: This paper documents that the Fed’s monetary policy significantly influences hedge funds’ (HFs) exposure to the U.S. corporate bonds and global government bonds, with larger effects after 2015 concurrent with the Fed’s new era of money market operations. HFs’ aversion to bonds is greater during the GFC than during the COVID crisis. During crisis periods, HFs’ exposure to both corporate and government bonds is significantly lower than during non-crisis periods. Generally, HFs’ exposure to prime brokers is negative during crises but turns positive during non-crisis periods. Moreover, HFs’ idiosyncratic shock propagation increases from the pre- to the post-COVID period, as they shift from net receivers to net transmitters of shocks and occupy a more central position in bond markets

AI.tldr: 本文研究美联储货币政策对 hedge funds 在美国公司债和全球政府债券中风险敞口的影响，发现政策影响显著，尤其是2015年后影响更大。对冲基金在危机时期对债券的规避更强，且其与prime brokers的关系在危机和非危机时期呈现正负反转。COVID前后，对冲基金从冲击接受者转变为冲击传播者，系统性重要性上升。
AI.research_question: 美联储货币政策如何影响对冲基金在美国公司债和全球政府债券中的风险敞口？
AI.motivation: 理解美联储货币政策通过对冲基金渠道对债券市场稳定性和风险传导的影响，特别是在危机时期和非危机时期的差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 货币政策传导机制、对冲基金风险承担渠道、金融网络中的冲击传播理论
AI.method: 基于对冲基金持仓数据的实证分析，对比金融危机、新冠疫情期和非危机时期的差异，分析2015年前后美联储货币市场操作新范式的影响。
AI.findings: 1) 美联储货币政策显著影响对冲基金对公司债和全球政府债的敞口，2015年后影响更大；2) 对冲基金在金融危机期对债券的规避强于新冠危机期；3) 危机时期对冲基金对prime brokers的敞口为负，非危机时期为正；4) COVID后对冲基金从冲击净接受者转为净传播者，在债券市场中占据更核心位置。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了货币政策对对冲基金风险承担影响的理论，揭示了危机类型差异和冲击传播角色的动态变化。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构理解对冲基金在债券市场中的系统性风险传导机制提供参考，有助于危机防范和政策制定。

title: Individualism
affiliations: School of Social and Political Sciences, University of Lincoln

detail.title: Individualism

declarations.funderStatement: The author is grateful for the generous support of the Institute for Humane Studies (IHS) Discourse Initiative and the Center for Governance and Markets at the University of Pittsburgh.

detail.abstract: What cultural traits are compatible with stable liberal institutions, and can individualist cultures sustain themselves over the long run? This chapter addresses both questions. It first establishes the relationship between formal institutions and culture, using the analogy of traffic rules and driving norms to show how each shapes and depends upon the other in ways that defy clean causal separation. It then argues that cultural individualism makes a surprising and empirically well-documented contribution to the pro-social fabric of liberal societies: far from producing atomism and moral corrosion, individualist cultures are associated with expanded charitable giving, greater gender and racial equality, more effective commons governance, and more efficient commercial institutions. The chapter then confronts two serious related internal challenges to liberal individualism: demography and social trust. The chapter concludes that the same capacity for self-criticism and institutional adaptation that critics identify as a fatal weakness is in fact liberalism's principal evolutionary resource.

AI.tldr: 本章论证了文化个人主义并非如批评者所言导致社会原子化和道德腐蚀，反而通过促进慈善捐赠、性别种族平等、公共资源治理和商业效率，为自由制度提供社会凝聚力；同时指出自由主义的自我批判和制度适应能力是其应对人口与社会信任挑战的核心进化资源。
AI.research_question: 什么样的文化特质与稳定的自由制度相容？个人主义文化能否长期维持自身？
AI.motivation: 回应批评者认为个人主义文化会导致社会原子化、道德腐蚀和制度不稳定的观点，以及自由主义面临的人口结构与社会信任两大内部挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度与文化的互构关系（以交通规则与驾驶规范的类比说明），文化个人主义与社会资本的关联理论，自由主义的自我批判与制度适应能力理论。
AI.method: 理论论证与经验证据结合，通过文献综述和案例比较（慈善捐赠、性别种族平等、公共资源治理、商业效率）进行实证支撑。
AI.findings: 个人主义文化与更广泛的慈善捐赠、更高的性别与种族平等、更有效的公共资源治理以及更高效的商业制度相关联；自由主义的自我批判和制度适应能力是其应对内部挑战的关键优势而非弱点。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了"个人主义必然导致社会原子化和道德腐蚀"的传统观点，建立了个人主义文化与亲社会行为之间的正向关联理论框架；重新定义了自由主义的"自我批判"特质——从被批评的缺陷重新界定为进化优势。
AI.practical_contributions: 为自由制度的长期维持提供了文化层面的辩护和策略启示，说明应珍视而非压制自由主义的自我批判传统和制度适应能力，以应对人口结构变化和社会信任下降等现实挑战。

title: Who Reaches the Top? Intergenerational Wealth Transfers, Wealth Inequality and Wealth Mobility in the United States

detail.title: Who Reaches the Top? Intergenerational Wealth Transfers, Wealth Inequality and Wealth Mobility in the United States
detail.abstract: How much do gifts and inheritances shape who reaches the top of the U.S. wealth distribution? I use the Panel Study of Income Dynamics (PSID) over 2001-2021. Intergenerational wealth transfers concentrate sharply among the wealthy. By their early sixties, 70% of a cohort's top 10% have received a wealth transfer, against 24% of the bottom. Among recipients, those in the top 10% receive wealth transfers worth 16% of lifetime earnings, against 7-11% elsewhere. Yet wealth transfers lower within-cohort wealth inequality by less than one percent. Wealth transfers mechanically account for 21% of intergenerational and 7% of intragenerational wealth mobility. The reason is timing: top 10% recipients were already wealthy before any wealth transfer arrived. Family background and unmeasured early-life support from parents likely matter more.

AI.tldr: 本文利用PSID数据研究了美国财富转移（赠与和遗产）对财富分配顶端群体的影响。发现财富转移高度集中于富人群体，但实际对财富不平等和代际流动性的影响有限，因为富人早在收到转移前就已富有。
AI.research_question: 赠与和遗产如何塑造美国财富分配顶端群体的地位？
AI.motivation: 探讨财富转移（遗产与赠与）对财富不平等和代际流动性的实际影响，纠正"财富转移是贫富差距主因"的常见认知。
AI.theoretical_framework: 代际财富转移理论、财富不平等与流动性理论
AI.method: 使用PSID 2001-2021年面板数据，分析财富转移的分布特征、其对不平等和流动性的机械贡献。
AI.findings: ①财富转移高度集中于最富有的10%群体（70%收到过转移，而底层仅24%）；②转移金额占比：顶层16%的终身收入，其他阶层7-11%；③财富转移对同期群内不平等降低不到1%；④机械解释了代际财富流动性的21%和代内流动性的7%；⑤关键原因是时间差：顶层在收到转移前已经富有。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了"财富转移是财富不平等主要驱动因素"的传统观点，揭示了财富转移的时间顺序与事前财富积累的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为遗产税政策设计提供实证依据，提示政策应更多关注早期家庭背景和未测量的父母支持，而非仅聚焦于财富转移本身。

A Microeconomic Analysis of the Luxury Fragrance Industry in Oman: 
A Case Study of Amouage’s Market Structure, Price Elasticity of Demand, Supply & Demand, and Government Intervention

A Microeconomic Analysis of the Luxury Fragrance Industry in Oman: 
A Case Study of Amouage’s Market Structure, Price Elasticity of Demand, Supply & Demand, and Government Intervention

detail.abstract:
This report uses microeconomic theory to study Amouage, an Omani luxury fragrance brand founded in 1983. The analysis covers four main areas: market structure, price elasticity of demand (PED), supply and demand, and government intervention. All data comes from published industry reports, company press releases, and credible news sources.
Amouage operates under monopolistic competition — a market with many competing brands, each selling a distinct product. Thanks to its Omani royal heritage, UNESCO-protected frankincense, and ultra-high concentration (30–40%+), Amouage can charge premium prices of $250–$550 per bottle. In 2025, the brand reached $430M+ in total sales, a +66% increase from the previous year (Business of Fashion, 2026).
A key finding is that Amouage's demand is inelastic, meaning customers are not highly sensitive to price changes. The estimated Price Elasticity of Demand (PED) is approximately −0.3 to −0.5. This indicates that price increases do not lead to a significant drop in sales, allowing Amouage to maintain premium prices without losing most of its customer base (Business Research Insights; Business of Fashion, 2026).
On the supply side, the main challenges are rising raw material costs (oud, Bulgarian rose, and vetiver went up 20–40% in 2024–25) and a production limit of around 25,000 bottles per week. Amouage manages these pressures by owning its own frankincense grove (vertical integration), running a 100% solar-powered factory, and leveraging capital from L'Oréal's minority stake to expand its boutiques from 16 to 25 globally (DataIntelo, 2025; Business of Fashion, 2025a).
Two government interventions are studied: Oman's Vision 2040 industrial policy, which addresses under-investment in positive externalities, and the Oman IP Law framework, which tackles information asymmetry caused by counterfeiting. Finally, four policy recommendations are proposed by government regulators, each addressing a specific market failure.

AI.tldr: 本文运用微观经济学理论分析阿曼奢侈香水品牌Amouage，涵盖市场结构、需求价格弹性、供需及政府干预。主要发现：该品牌在垄断竞争市场中凭借王室传承与珍稀原料实现高溢价，需求缺乏弹性（PED约-0.3至-0.5），通过垂直整合与太阳能工厂应对供给挑战，并针对正外部性不足与信息不对称问题提出四项政策建议。
AI.research_question: Amouage品牌在奢侈香水市场中如何运用微观经济学原理实现差异化竞争与可持续盈利？
AI.motivation: 以Amouage为案例，研究奢侈品牌如何在垄断竞争市场中通过稀缺资源、品牌故事和垂直整合维持高溢价，并为政府干预市场失灵提供政策建议。
AI.theoretical_framework: 垄断竞争理论、需求价格弹性（PED）、供需理论、政府干预（正外部性、信息不对称）
AI.method: 基于行业报告、公司官方发布和可信新闻来源的二手资料分析
AI.findings: Amouage在垄断竞争市场中凭借王室背书、UNESCO保护乳香及高浓度配方实现$250-$550高价；需求缺乏弹性（PED≈-0.3至-0.5），2025年销售$4.3亿（同比+66%）；供给端面临原料成本上涨20-40%及周产2.5万瓶限制，通过垂直整合乳香种植园、100%太阳能工厂和L'Oréal投资扩张应对。
AI.theory_contributions: 为奢侈品牌在垄断竞争市场中的需求缺乏弹性特征提供了实证案例，验证了品牌稀缺性与垂直整合对供给约束的缓解作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为奢侈品行业管理者提供了关于定价策略、供应链垂直整合及可持续生产的参考；为政府提供了通过产业政策（Vision 2040）和知识产权法（IP Law）纠正市场失灵的具体建议。

title: Circulating Histone Chaperone Profiles As Novel Biomarkers for Early Lung Cancer Detection and Their Exploitation in Liquid Biopsies
affiliations: Maharshi Dayanand University, Rohtak and Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) - National Institute of Cancer Prevention and Research

detail.title: Circulating Histone Chaperone Profiles As Novel Biomarkers for Early Lung Cancer Detection and Their Exploitation in Liquid Biopsies

declarations.funderStatement: None.

detail.abstract: Lung cancer is substantial burden to health infrastructure around the world. Lung cancer diagnosis is challenging due to late-stage detection and false diagnosis. Thus, there is a need to discover novel biomarker for early detection. There is a growing potential of circulating DNA, histones and histone chaperones as innovative biomarkers in the early detection and prognosis of lung cancer. Although the field is still in its formative stages, preliminary findings suggest that alterations in the levels of circulating histone chaperones, such as ASF-1, may serve as valuable indicators of the dynamic interactions between tumor cells and the surrounding microenvironment. These interactions could provide critical insights into tumor progression, potentially revealing early signs of malignancy before conventional diagnostic methods become effective. However, much more research is needed to fully understand the underlying mechanisms that govern the release of histone chaperones into the bloodstream. Additionally, a deeper investigation into their precise roles in tumorigenesis and their potential impact on cancer biology is essential for assessing their utility as reliable biomarkers. At present, these biomarkers hold promise, but their clinical application requires further validation through rigorous, largescale studies that can confirm their diagnostic and prognostic capabilities. Key to realizing the clinical potential of circulating histone chaperones will be the development of highly sensitive and specific assays capable of detecting and quantifying these biomarkers with accuracy. Furthermore, advances in liquid biopsy technologies, which offer non-invasive alternatives to traditional tissue biopsies, will play a pivotal role in enabling the widespread use of circulating histone chaperones in routine clinical practice.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了循环组蛋白伴侣（如ASF-1）作为肺癌早期检测和预后生物标志物的潜力，指出该领域仍处于初级阶段，需要更多研究和临床验证。
AI.research_question: 循环组蛋白伴侣能否作为肺癌早期检测和预后的新型生物标志物？
AI.motivation: 肺癌是全球健康基础设施的重大负担，由于晚期诊断和误诊问题突出，亟需发现新型生物标志物以实现早期检测。
AI.theoretical_framework: 循环DNA、组蛋白及组蛋白伴侣作为创新型生物标志物的理论基础，涉及肿瘤细胞与微环境的动态相互作用。
AI.method: 文献综述与初步研究发现的归纳分析，指出现有研究仍处于形成阶段。
AI.findings: 循环组蛋白伴侣（如ASF-1）水平变化可能作为肿瘤-微环境动态互动的指示指标，有望在传统诊断方法生效前揭示早期恶性迹象。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了循环组蛋白伴侣作为肺癌生物标志物的概念框架，强调了其在肿瘤发生机制中的潜在作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 指出了临床应用中需要开发高灵敏度和特异性的检测方法，以及液体活检技术的进步对于推广循环组蛋白伴侣在常规临床实践中应用的重要性。

title: Twelve Years After the Perfect Storm: Why Digital Health Has Not Reformed Medicine

detail.title: Twelve Years After the Perfect Storm: Why Digital Health Has Not Reformed Medicine

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is Chief Research Officer at AKFA Medline University Hospital, an institution of the kind discussed in Section 5 as a potential site for the parallel ecosystem described; readers should weigh the constructive argument accordingly. The author declares no financial competing interests, and the institution had no role in the analysis, which rests on publicly available evidence.
declarations.funderStatement: Conducted as part of the author's role at AKFA Medline University Hospital, which provided no specific funding for this work

detail.abstract: In 2014, a widely cited perspective forecast that converging technologies-wearable biosensors, cloud computing, ubiquitous networks, and the maturing science of resilience and heart-rate variability-would displace medicine's acute-care episode model with a continuous, preventive "Extensive Care System." Twelve years on, every forecast ingredient has arrived, including the generative-AI synthesis layer the original could not name. The episode model is undiminished: U.S. national health expenditure reached $5.3 trillion, or 18.0% of GDP, in 2024 and is projected to approach 20.3% by 2033, with health spending growing faster than the economy throughout. This paper argues that the outcome is not a failure of technology or of the forecast, but the predictable equilibrium of an unchanged system. Three structural rails account for it: a fee-forservice incentive that prices the episode and persists even inside value-based contracts; a regulatory boundary at the line of diagnosis that admits continuous tools only by stripping their continuous, ipsative character; and an epistemic mismatch between categorical, populationnormed medicine and continuous, self-referenced physiological data. Together they ensure that any tool entering the clinic is absorbed into administrative automation rather than structural reform-the same mechanism that domesticated the biopsychosocial model a generation earlier. It follows that these tools' potential is located outside those rails, in a parallel ecosystem built on restored payer-beneficiary identity, ipsative epistemics, and first-class safety. We specify what that ecosystem requires, and where it is-and is not-defensible.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了2014年关于"广泛护理系统"预测为何未能实现，指出并非技术失败，而是医疗系统固有的三个结构性轨道（按服务收费激励、监管边界、认知不匹配）将连续监测工具吸收为行政自动化工具而非推动结构性改革，并提出在现有系统之外建立平行生态系统的解决方案。
AI.research_question: 为何2014年预测的从急性护理模式向连续预防性"广泛护理系统"的转变未能实现？连续健康监测技术的潜力在哪里才能真正释放？
AI.motivation: 可穿戴传感器、云计算、泛在网络和韧性科学等融合技术已全面成熟，但美国医疗支出仍持续增长、急性护理模式未发生根本改变，这一矛盾需要系统性的解释，而非归咎于技术或预测本身的失败。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构性轨道理论（三个"铁轨"：按服务收费激励、监管边界、认知不匹配），制度吸收/驯化理论（将激进技术转化为行政自动化工具），平行生态系统理论。
AI.method: 理论论证与历史比较分析（类比生物心理社会模型被驯化的历史案例）
AI.findings: 三个结构性轨道解释了连续监测工具为何被吸收为行政自动化而非推动结构性改革：1）按服务收费激励将诊疗定价为"事件"；2）监管边界停留在"诊断"线上，工具进入诊所时被剥离了连续性和个体参照特性；3）范畴化、群体规范的医学认知与连续、自参考的生理数据之间存在认识论错配。技术的真正潜力存在于现行系统之外的平行生态系统中。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"结构性轨道"这一分析框架来解释技术何以被制度吸收而非推动变革，为技术-制度互动理论提供了新的分析维度；揭示了连续监测技术与当代医学认识论之间的深层不兼容性。
AI.practical_contributions: 指出连续健康监测技术的真正应用潜力不在现有医疗体系内，而在基于恢复支付者-受益者同一性、个体参照认识论和"一等安全"的平行生态系统中，为技术创新者、政策制定者和投资者提供了战略方向指引。

title: Gold Mining Increases Malaria Burden in the Brazilian Amazon
affiliations: , University of California, Santa Barbara (UCSB) - Donald Bren School of Environmental Science & Management,  and University of California, Santa Barbara (UCSB)
