detail.abstract: The rapid expansion of gold mining has the potential to dramatically affect human health and wellbeing. While gold mining can provide a source of income in rural communities, it simultaneously transforms the environment in ways that can negatively affect health. In particular, gold mining's changes to local hydrology and migration patterns have been associated with increased rates of malaria transmission in the tropics. However, few studies have quantified the population-scale, causal effect of gold mining on malaria, or have investigated differential impacts on Indigenous communities who may be particularly vulnerable. Here, we quantify the causal effect that gold mining has had on malaria case rates in the Brazilian Amazon, a region where artisanal and small-scale gold mining has rapidly expanded. Applying quasi-experimental methods to longitudinal data on health and gold mining expansion, we show that gold mining significantly increases malaria prevalence across the Amazonian population. Indigenous peoples experience a disproportionate baseline malaria burden and share in the negative effects of gold mining. Health expenditures reduce the effect of gold mining on malaria, highlighting an opportunity to mitigate gold mining's negative health effects.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用准实验方法量化了巴西亚马逊地区金矿开采对疟疾发病率的因果效应，发现金矿开采显著增加了疟疾患病率，且原住民群体承受着不成比例的负担，但卫生支出可以缓解这一负面影响。
AI.research_question: 金矿开采对疟疾患病率有何因果效应？该效应在不同人群（特别是原住民群体）中是否存在差异？卫生支出能否缓解金矿开采对疟疾的负面影响？
AI.motivation: 金矿开采在热带地区迅速扩张，虽能带来经济收入，但同时改变水文和人口迁移模式，可能增加疟疾传播风险。然而，现有研究缺乏对金矿开采与疟疾之间因果关系的量化估计，也鲜有关注其对原住民群体的差异化影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境健康经济学、准实验因果推断、差异中的差异（Difference-in-Differences）方法。
AI.method: 采用准实验方法（如双重差分法），结合巴西亚马逊地区纵向健康数据与金矿开采扩张数据，进行因果效应估计。
AI.findings: 金矿开采显著增加了亚马逊地区人群的疟疾患病率；原住民群体本已承受更高的疟疾基线负担，并同样受到金矿开采的负面影响；卫生支出能够有效减轻金矿开采对疟疾的不利影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在大规模人口层面量化金矿开采对疟疾的因果效应，补充了环境变化与传染病传播关系的因果证据；揭示了经济活动外部性对弱势群体的差异化健康影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了金矿开采健康代价的量化依据，强调了增加卫生支出以缓解采矿负面影响的可行路径，尤其有助于保护原住民社区的健康福祉。

title: The Collective Subject and Distributed Responsibility: Ontological Conditions for Organisational Accountability

detail.title: The Collective Subject and Distributed Responsibility: Ontological Conditions for Organisational Accountability

declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. Independent research project.

detail.abstract:
This article addresses a question that the ATTS series has left open: who bears
responsibility when a decision is made collectively and its consequences are distributed
across many subjects? The starting point is the Closure Theorem of the Moral Field (T1),
established in the article "The Asymmetry Problem: Causal Action Without Moral Agency in
Delegated Systems" (Hlynskyi, 2026d; PhilArchive: HLYTAP), and the mechanism of
structural tension (S6), described in "Structural Tension and the Visibility of Loss"
(Hlynskyi, 2026e; PhilArchive: HLYSTA). Both were formulated for the individual subject.
The problem of many hands (Thompson, 1980) captures the phenomenology of responsibility
diffusion in complex organisations — but offers no ontological explanation for why that
responsibility does not simply disappear.
The central thesis is this: corporations, states, and similar collective structures can be
ontological subjects under the Axiom of the Subject (A1), provided they possess a constituted
state-space and that irreversible changes to that space are ontologically non-neutral for them
as bearers of a given type. Collective responsibility is not a metaphor, nor is it reducible to
the sum of individual responsibilities. It arises from the collective structure's capacity for
irreversible loss as a whole. At the same time, collective responsibility does not replace
individual responsibility — both levels exist simultaneously.
The article derives Lemma 3 (the indestructibility of the collective connection) and
unfolds the structural requirements for accountability of collective subjects, following from
the principles of responsibility locus (S2), diffusion (S3), structural tension (S6), and
legitimacy (S7). The boundary case of a distributed AI system is tested against A1. Readers
unfamiliar with ATTS terminology may consult the glossary of abbreviations at the end of
this article before reading.

AI.tldr: 本文论证了在集体决策与后果分散的情境下，集体结构（如公司、国家）可以成为本体论意义上的责任主体，集体责任既非隐喻也不可还原为个体责任之和，同时与个体责任并存。
AI.research_question: 当决策是集体做出的且后果分散于众多主体时，谁应承担责任？集体责任为何不会在复杂组织中消散？
AI.motivation: ATTS系列此前未解决集体决策中的责任归属问题。"多手问题"（Thompson, 1980）描述了责任扩散的现象学，但未提供为何责任不会消失的本体论解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 道德场封闭定理（T1）、结构张力机制（S6）、主体公理（A1）、责任定位原则（S2）、扩散原则（S3）、合法性原则（S7）
AI.method: 概念分析与公理演绎：从主体公理（A1）出发，推导集体主体成立的条件，并检验分布式AI系统作为边界案例。
AI.findings: 集体结构若拥有构成性的状态空间且其不可逆变化对该结构作为特定类型的承载者具有本体论上的非中性，则可在本体论意义上成为主体。集体责任源于集体整体承受不可逆损失的能力，且与个体责任同时存在。推导出引理3（集体联结的不可摧毁性）。
AI.theory_contributions: 为集体责任提供了本体论基础，超越了"多手问题"的纯现象学描述；提出集体责任与个体责任并存的双层责任模型；将主体公理扩展至集体结构，并通过分布式AI系统进行边界检验。
AI.practical_contributions: 为复杂组织（公司、国家、AI系统）中的责任归属提供分析框架，有助于解决实际问责难题。

detail.abstract:
This paper introduces Kumar’s Helm, a five facet, multiplicative, agent centric, time dependent
structural model of two agent competitive outcomes. Each agent is represented by a single
driver who manifests through five named facets: Vessel (the platform of the agent), Experience
(accumulated history that has shaped the agent), Mindset (the time varying disposition at the
moment of decision), Opportunity (the personal opportunity the situation affords the agent),
and Discernment (the meta cognitive capacity to be informed by the past without being guided
by it). Two of the five facets vary with the moment (Mindset and Discernment); three are
roughly stable on the time scale of a single contest (Vessel, Experience, Opportunity in its slow
varying form). The probability that one agent prevails over another at moment t is the ratio of
two multiplicative driver states placed inside a Bradley Terry sigmoid with a decisiveness
parameter. The Helm extends paired comparison models (Bradley Terry, Luce, McFadden,
McKelvey and Palfrey, TrueSkill) by making the agent the active subject of all five facets rather
than a static rating, by introducing within contest time variation in Mindset, and by adding a
meta cognitive Discernment facet that captures why accumulated experience sometimes helps
and sometimes hurts. It honours a long lineage in decision theory, decision process theory,
psychology of expertise, and philosophy of practical wisdom, and proposes a synthesis that
occupies a position not held by any prior eponymous law. Empirical anchoring is established in
a companion paper that tests an Updated Helm specification on Formula One race outcomes
from 1980 to 2024 and finds that it matches feature augmented gradient boosting on out of
sample AUC in the modern qualifying era. The aphoristic companion of the Helm: the faster car
doesn’t always win, the driver does, informed by the past, present in the moment, free to
choose.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Kumar's Helm，一个五维度、乘法型、以主体为中心、随时间变化的二元竞争结果结构模型。该模型通过Vessel（载体）、Experience（经验）、Mindset（心态）、Opportunity（机会）和Discernment（洞察力）五个维度刻画竞争主体，将竞争胜率定义为Bradley-Terry型sigmoid函数，拓展了配对比较模型家族，并引入元认知洞察力维度解释经验为何有时帮助有时阻碍表现。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够捕捉竞争主体内在动态特征（而非静态评分）的二元竞争结果预测模型？
AI.motivation: 现有配对比较模型（Bradley-Terry、Luce、McFadden、TrueSkill等）将主体视为静态评分，无法解释同一主体在不同时刻表现差异的原因，也无法回答"为什么积累的经验有时有帮助、有时反而有害"这一核心问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: Bradley-Terry配对比较模型；决策理论；决策过程理论；专长心理学；实践智慧哲学（亚里士多德phronesis传统）。
AI.method: 提出Kumar's Helm五维度乘法结构模型，将两个主体的驱动状态比值嵌入Bradley-Terry型sigmoid函数（含决断参数），其中心态和洞察力随时间变化，载体、经验和机会在单次竞赛时间尺度上大致稳定。
AI.findings: 在1980-2024年F1赛事数据上，更新后的Helm模型在现代排位赛时代的样本外AUC指标上与特征增强的梯度提升方法相当。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）将主体从静态评分扩展为五维主动主体；（2）引入竞赛内时间变化的心态维度；（3）增加元认知洞察力维度，解释经验的双刃剑效应；（4）在决策理论、决策过程理论、专长心理学和实践智慧哲学之间提出综合，占据此前没有任何同名定律的位置。
AI.practical_contributions: 为竞技比赛（如F1）的胜负预测提供了理论驱动、可解释的结构化模型，在样本外表现与机器学习方法相当，同时保留了因果解释力。

title: Sex Differences in the Influence of Maternal Postnatal Stress on Young Children’s Cognitive Abilities: Evidence from a German Large-scale Study
affiliations: Leibniz Institute for Educational Trajectories

detail.title: Sex Differences in the Influence of Maternal Postnatal Stress on Young Children’s Cognitive Abilities: Evidence from a German Large-scale Study
detail.abstract: Maternal postnatal stress is often reported to be negatively associated with early child development in, for example, the cognitive domain. While cognitive abilities in boys are sometimes found to be more negatively associated with maternal postnatal stress, empirical findings are heterogeneous and often draw on small samples that complicate formal moderation testing. Using large-scale data from the Newborn Cohort of the German National Educational Panel Study (NEPS-SC1), the current study investigated the longitudinal association of maternal postnatal stress and basic cognitive abilities as measured by habituation-based indicators by children’s sex assigned at birth; the analytic sample included three measurement points from n = 3,439 children (at an average of 7, 14, and 17 months of age; 50.95% boys). Self-reported maternal postnatal stress was modeled as latent factors at 7 and 14 months, and for children’s basic cognitive abilities, looking behavior in a fixed-trial habituation task was modeled as latent factors (i.e., initial engagement and looking decrement). Measurement invariance across child sex was supported. Overall, maternal postnatal stress was not robustly associated with the habituation-based indicators, and there were no sex-differentiated pathways. Therefore, the current findings suggest limited population-level evidence of sex-differentiated susceptibility to maternal postnatal stress in basic cognitive abilities.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用德国国家教育小组研究新生儿队列的大规模数据（N=3,439），发现母亲产后压力与婴儿基本认知能力（习惯化指标）之间无显著关联，且不存在儿童性别差异效应。
AI.research_question: 母亲产后压力与婴儿基本认知能力之间的关系是否因儿童出生性别而异？
AI.motivation: 已有文献报告母亲产后压力与儿童认知发展呈负相关，且男孩可能更易受影响，但现有研究样本量小、结果异质性强，缺乏正式的调节效应检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 产后压力与儿童早期认知发展理论；性别差异易感性理论（性差分化易感性假说）
AI.method: 基于德国国家教育小组研究新生儿队列（NEPS-SC1）的大规模纵向数据（3,439名儿童，7、14、17个月三次测量），采用潜变量建模分析母亲自报产后压力与婴儿习惯化任务中注视行为（初始参与度和注视衰减）的关系，并检验测量不变性及性别调节效应。
AI.findings: 母亲产后压力与婴儿习惯化指标之间无稳健关联，且未发现性别分化的路径。测量不变性在男女婴儿间成立。
AI.theory_contributions: 在人群水平上对性别差异易感性假说进行了大样本检验，发现有限证据支持该假说在基本认知能力领域的适用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示干预政策无需针对不同性别婴儿采取差异化策略来缓解产后压力对认知的影响，资源可更均匀分配。

title: Molecular Surgery: Regulating mRNA-CRISPR Gene Editing as a Procedure, Not a Product
affiliations: and

detail.title: Molecular Surgery: Regulating mRNA-CRISPR Gene Editing as a Procedure, Not a Product

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Dr Coller is a founding partner of the Rare REPAIRx consortium and a founder of the Alliance for mRNA Medicines and Tevard Biosciences. Tevard develops RNA-based treatments for Duchenne muscular dystrophy using AAV-delivered suppressor tRNAs, a fundamentally distinct technology from the mRNA-CRISPR platform described in this article. Dr Kassim is Chief Technology Officer of Genomic Medicines at Danaher Corporation. The article specifically references two Danaher Life Sciences companies (Aldevron and Integrated DNA Technologies), Acuitas Therapeutics (an independent partner), and the Danaher-IGI Beacon for CRISPR Cures program. Dr Kassim played a pivotal role in the Danaher-supported manufacturing of the personalized CRISPR therapy for the patient described in this article. Dr Kassim is also an Advisor to RA Capital Management. No other disclosures were reported.
declarations.funderStatement: The authors received no specific funding for this work. Dr Coller acknowledges general support from the National Institutes of Health (R35GM144114) and Johns Hopkins University.

detail.abstract: In February 2025, a six-month-old infant became the first person to receive a personalized CRISPR gene-editing therapy, demonstrating both what is possible and what is missing. Current US regulatory infrastructure treats every personalized gene-editing therapy as a new pharmaceutical product, requiring independent manufacturing validation, separate clinical evidence packages, and individual regulatory review. FDA approval throughput is approximately 50 novel drugs annually through CDER and seven to nine cell and gene therapy products through CBER. These pathways cannot scale to the thousands of patients with treatable genetic conditions. We propose regulating personalized mRNA-CRISPR as a procedure rather than as an individual product. The framework comprises a two-tier regulatory structure separating one-time platform validation from per-patient authorization; a two-node Certified Molecular Surgery infrastructure linking a Certified Manufacturing Network with an accredited clinical center; procedural reimbursement modeled on transplantation and CART ; and a federal injury compensation program modeled on the National Vaccine Injury Compensation Program. The architecture complements the FDA's Plausible Mechanism Framework with operational specifics that complementary policy proposals have not yet specified.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将个性化CRISPR基因编辑疗法从按"药品"监管转为按"医疗程序"监管，以解决现有审批体系无法规模化满足数千名遗传病患者需求的问题，并设计了包含两级监管、认证网络、程序化报销和联邦补偿的完整架构。
AI.research_question: 如何改革现行监管框架，使个性化CRISPR基因编辑疗法能够规模化地惠及更多遗传性疾病患者？
AI.motivation: 2025年2月首例婴儿接受个性化CRISPR治疗的成功案例揭示了现有监管体系的瓶颈：每款个性化基因疗法都被当作新药审批，FDA每年仅能批准50种新药和7-9种细胞/基因疗法，无法满足数千名可治遗传病患者的治疗需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 程序化监管理论（Procedure-based Regulation）、平台验证与个体授权分离的两级监管架构、FDA合理机制框架（Plausible Mechanism Framework）的延伸应用。
AI.method: 政策分析与制度设计研究，通过对比现有药品监管路径与程序化监管路径的差异，借鉴移植医学、CAR-T疗法、国家疫苗伤害赔偿计划等现有制度经验，构建新的监管架构。
AI.findings: 提出了"个性化mRNA-CRISPR作为医疗程序而非产品"的新监管框架，包含：两级监管结构（一次性平台验证+每患者授权）、双节点认证分子手术基础设施（认证制造网络+认证临床中心）、基于移植和CAR-T模式的程序化报销、以及联邦伤害补偿计划。
AI.theory_contributions: 为FDA的合理机制框架（Plausible Mechanism Framework）提供了可操作的具体实施方案，填补了现有政策提案在操作细节上的空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为个性化CRISPR基因编辑疗法的规模化临床应用提供了可行的监管路径，有望大幅提升遗传性疾病患者的治疗可及性。

title: When Oil Narratives Become Bank Risk

detail.title: When Oil Narratives Become Bank Risk
detail.abstract: Oil-market news can signal very different risks for banks exposed to oil-producing regions. This paper studies how newspaper-based oil narratives are associated with U.S. bank balance sheets. Supply-disruption narratives predict higher cumulative loan-loss provisions and net charge-offs, lower loan growth, lower deposit growth, and weaker short-run profitability among more oil-exposed banks. Demand-salience narratives move in the opposite direction, predicting stronger lending, deposit growth, and profitability, while provisions and charge-offs decline. These findings show that oil narratives do not have one banking effect: some oil stories become bank risk, while others coincide with expansion in oil-exposed banking markets.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了基于报纸的石油叙事如何影响美国银行的资产负债表，发现供应中断叙事对石油敞口较大的银行预示着更高的贷款损失准备金和净冲销、更低的贷款和存款增长以及更弱的短期盈利能力，而需求凸显叙事则相反，预示着更强的贷款、存款增长和盈利能力。
AI.research_question: 石油市场新闻如何通过不同叙事类型（供应中断叙事 vs 需求凸显叙事）影响美国银行的资产负债表行为？
AI.motivation: 石油新闻对不同地区银行可能传递截然不同的风险信号，传统研究往往将油价波动视为单一风险因子，忽略了新闻叙事内容的异质性对银行业的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 石油叙事分类理论（供应冲击 vs 需求冲击）、银行风险暴露理论、信息传导机制理论
AI.method: 基于报纸文本的叙事分析方法，结合银行资产负债表数据，考察不同石油叙事对银行各项财务指标（贷款损失准备金、净冲销、贷款增长、存款增长、盈利能力）的预测能力。
AI.findings: 供应中断叙事与石油敞口大的银行的贷款损失准备金和净冲销正相关，与贷款增长、存款增长和短期盈利能力负相关；需求凸显叙事则表现出相反模式，与银行扩张性指标正相关，与风险指标负相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了石油新闻叙事并非单一维度，不同叙事类型对银行产生截然不同的经济效应，丰富了石油-金融关联的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为银行风险管理者和监管机构提供了区分不同石油新闻类型进行风险预警和监管决策的实践依据，有助于更精准地评估石油市场信息对银行体系的异质性影响。

title: Economic Incentives and Farmers’ Willingness to Pay for Aflatoxin Control Measures in Groundnut Production: A Case Study from Mhuju EPA, Malawi
affiliations: Lilongwe University of Agriculture and Natural Resources, Lilongwe University of Agriculture and Natural Resources, Lilongwe University of Agriculture and Natural Resources and Lilongwe University of Agriculture and Natural Resources

detail.title: Economic Incentives and Farmers’ Willingness to Pay for Aflatoxin Control Measures in Groundnut Production: A Case Study from Mhuju EPA, Malawi
detail.abstract: Aflatoxin contamination remains a major food safety and public health concern in sub-Saharan Africa, particularly in Malawi, where groundnuts are an important food and cash crop. Despite the availability of recommended aflatoxin control practices, adoption among smallholder farmers remains low, partly due to limited economic incentives and financial constraints. This study examined the economic incentives and willingness to pay (WTP) for aflatoxin control technologies among smallholder groundnut farmers in Mhuju Extension Planning Area (EPA) in Rumphi District, northern Malawi. A cross-sectional survey involving 126 groundnut farmers was conducted between April and May 2025 using structured questionnaires administered through KoBoToolbox. Data were analyzed using descriptive statistics, Chi-square tests, and logistic regression. The findings revealed that awareness of aflatoxin contamination was generally low, with only 13.5% of respondents reporting prior knowledge of aflatoxin, despite almost all respondents recognizing mold in groundnuts. Nevertheless, 77.8% of farmers expressed willingness to pay for aflatoxin-safe drying and storage technologies, with an average WTP of MWK 21,625 (approximately USD 12.36). Economic incentives emerged as the primary driver of adoption, cited by 71% of respondents, while health concerns played a secondary role. Significant gender differences were observed, with men generally demonstrating higher awareness, income levels, and willingness to pay compared to women. Income and education level, however, were not significantly associated with willingness to pay. The study concludes that aflatoxin control among smallholder farmers is largely shaped by economic considerations rather than food safety awareness alone. In the absence of strong market incentives, quality differentiation, and effective regulatory enforcement, farmers are less likely to prioritize aflatoxin mitigation practices. The findings highlight the need for incentive-driven interventions that combine affordable technologies, improved market systems, targeted awareness campaigns, and gender-sensitive approaches to enhance adoption of aflatoxin control measures and improve both food safety and rural livelihoods in Malawi.

AI.tldr: 本研究调查了马拉维小农户花生种植者对黄曲霉毒素控制技术的经济激励与支付意愿，发现尽管黄曲霉毒素认知水平很低（仅13.5%），但77.8%的农户表达了支付意愿，经济激励而非健康意识是主要驱动因素。
AI.research_question: 马拉维小农户花生种植者对黄曲霉毒素控制技术的经济激励与支付意愿（WTP）是怎样的？哪些因素影响其采纳行为？
AI.motivation: 黄曲霉毒素污染在撒哈拉以南非洲（特别是马拉维）是严重的食品安全和公共卫生问题，但推荐的控制技术采纳率低，部分原因是缺乏经济激励和资金约束。需要理解农户的经济动机以设计有效干预措施。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济激励理论、农户采纳行为理论、支付意愿分析框架
AI.method: 2025年4-5月间在马拉维北部Rumphi区Mhuju推广规划区对126名花生种植者进行横截面问卷调查（使用KoBoToolbox），数据采用描述性统计、卡方检验和逻辑回归分析。
AI.findings: (1) 黄曲霉毒素认知率极低，仅13.5%受访者听说过，但几乎所有人都能识别花生霉变；(2) 77.8%的农户愿意支付黄曲霉毒素安全干燥和储存技术，平均WTP为MWK 21,625（约12.36美元）；(3) 经济激励是采纳的首要驱动力（71%受访者提及），健康担忧为次要；(4) 男性在认知、收入和支付意愿方面显著高于女性；(5) 收入和教育水平与支付意愿无显著关联。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了在低收入小农户背景下，经济激励而非食品安全认知是黄曲霉毒素控制技术采纳的主要驱动因素，对传统食品安全意识提升干预策略提出了挑战。
AI.practical_contributions: 为马拉维及类似地区设计黄曲霉毒素干预措施提供了基于证据的建议：应侧重激励驱动型干预，结合可负担技术、改善市场体系、针对性宣传活动和性别敏感策略，而非仅靠提高认知。

title: Age buffers entrepreneurial exit during macroeconomic shocks: Evidence from Spain, 2005–2024
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Cantabria - Department of Economics and University of Agder

detail.title: Age buffers entrepreneurial exit during macroeconomic shocks: Evidence from Spain, 2005–2024
detail.abstract: This study examines whether older entrepreneurs are less sensitive to macroeconomic shocks than younger entrepreneurs. Using repeated cross-sectional data from the Global Entrepreneurship Monitor Adult Population Survey for Spain from 2005 to 2024, we analyze entrepreneurial exit among 72,204 recent business owners across four macroeconomic periods: pre-recession (2005-2008), Great Recession (2009-2014), recovery (2015-2020), and pandemic/post-pandemic disruption (2021-2024). We estimate logistic regression models of business exit with age-by-period interactions, controlling for gender, education, and entrepreneurial orientation. Crisis periods are associated with substantially higher exit overall, but that increase weakens as age rises. Older entrepreneurs do not display a universal survival advantage outside crisis periods; rather, their exit rates rise less sharply when macroeconomic conditions deteriorate. Descriptive evidence also suggests that finance-related exits are less common among older founders, whereas retirement-related exits are more common. The study contributes a focused insight to entrepreneurship research by showing that heterogeneity in entrepreneurial exit is contingent on the interaction between founder age and macroeconomic conditions.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，年长企业家在经济危机时期的退出率上升幅度小于年轻企业家，未危机时并无普遍生存优势，表明年龄与宏观经济条件共同影响创业退出。
AI.research_question: 年长企业家是否比年轻企业家对宏观经济冲击更不敏感？
AI.motivation: 已有研究对企业家年龄与退出的关系结论不一，忽略了宏观经济周期这一调节因素，本文旨在揭示年龄效应如何随宏观条件变化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于生命周期理论、人力资本理论和宏观经济冲击理论，探讨年龄与宏观经济周期的交互作用对创业退出的影响。
AI.method: 利用西班牙2005-2024年全球创业观察数据（72,204名近期企业主），划分四个宏观经济时期（前衰退、大衰退、复苏、疫情后），采用含年龄-时期交互项的Logistic回归模型，控制性别、教育、创业导向。
AI.findings: （1）危机时期退出率总体显著上升；（2）但退出率上升幅度随年龄增长而减弱；（3）非危机时期年长企业家并无普遍生存优势；（4）年长企业家财务相关退出较少，退休相关退出较多。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了创业退出的异质性取决于创始人年龄与宏观经济条件的交互作用，细化了创业退出理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者在不同经济时期设计差异化创业支持方案提供依据，也启示投资者和企业主关注年龄与宏观环境的匹配。

title: Interpretable deep learning reveals association-unresolved loci shaped by linkage disequilibrium
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Kongju National University and Chungnam National University

detail.title: Interpretable deep learning reveals association-unresolved loci shaped by linkage disequilibrium
detail.abstract: Understanding how deep-learning models prioritize genomic loci is essential for improving the transparency and biological utility of genomic prediction in crop breeding. In this study, we developed an interpretable multilayer perceptron framework to predict heading date and maturity date in bread wheat (Triticumaestivum L.) using 22,786 single-nucleotide polymorphism markers from 566 accessions of the K-wheat core collection. We compared model-derived feature importance with genome-wide association study signals and integrated linkage disequilibrium, functional annotation, and population differentiation evidence to prioritize candidate loci. Three feature-importance methods, DeepLIFT, Feature Ablation, and Integrated Gradients, produced highly consistent marker rankings. For heading date, 18 of the 20 highest-ranked markers were shared across methods, whereas all 20 top-ranked markers were identical for maturity date. Feature-importance-selected marker subsets improved prediction performance compared with the full marker set and size-matched random subsets, indicating that the selected markers were enriched for prediction-relevant signals. Several prioritized regions contained biologically plausible candidate genes, including VIN3-like and FPF1-like genes for heading date and sucrose synthase and MADS-box transcription factor genes for maturity date. Concordance between feature importance and association mapping was trait dependent. Maturity date showed partial overlap, including AX-94435438 and AX-94600258, whereas heading-date signals were largely distinct from genome-wide significant association loci. Integration with XP-CLR and XP-EHH scans further identified candidate regions supported by predictive relevance and population differentiation. These results demonstrate that explainable deep learning can complement association analysis and support transparent marker prioritization for complex wheat phenology traits.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种可解释的多层感知机框架，利用小麦SNP标记预测抽穗期和成熟期，并通过多种特征重要性方法与GWAS、LD、功能注释和群体分化证据整合，优先筛选出与预测相关且生物学可解释的候选基因位点。
AI.research_question: 如何利用可解释的深度学习框架，结合特征重要性分析与基因组关联分析，优先筛选出对小麦抽穗期和成熟期具有预测价值和生物学意义的候选基因组位点？
AI.motivation: 提高深度学习模型在作物育种基因组预测中的透明度和生物学实用性，克服传统"黑箱"模型的局限性，使模型识别的关键位点具有可解释性和生物学依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可解释人工智能（XAI）、深度学习特征重要性方法（DeepLIFT、Feature Ablation、Integrated Gradients）、全基因组关联分析（GWAS）、连锁不平衡（LD）、群体分化扫描（XP-CLR、XP-EHH）
AI.method: 基于22,786个SNP标记和566份K-小麦核心种质材料，构建可解释的多层感知机模型；使用DeepLIFT、Feature Ablation和Integrated Gradients三种方法评估特征重要性；与GWAS信号、LD、功能注释和群体分化证据进行整合分析。
AI.findings: 三种特征重要性方法标记排名高度一致（抽穗期20个最高排名标记中18个共享，成熟期20个全部一致）；特征重要性筛选的标记子集预测性能优于全标记集和随机子集；识别出包含VIN3-like、FPF1-like（抽穗期）和蔗糖合酶、MADS-box转录因子（成熟期）等生物学合理候选基因的优先区域；特征重要性与GWAS的一致性因性状而异（成熟期部分重叠，抽穗期基本独立）。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了可解释深度学习可以补充传统关联分析，为复杂性状候选基因优先排序提供透明且预测驱动的框架；揭示了特征重要性与关联映射之间性状依赖的互补关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为小麦育种提供了可解释的基因组预测工具，能够筛选出具有预测价值和生物学意义的标记子集，有助于加速作物分子育种中的基因位点优先排序和候选基因鉴定。

title: Dichotomic Search for Complex Multiobjective Optimization Problems
affiliations: University of Wuppertal, University of Wuppertal and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Dichotomic Search for Complex Multiobjective Optimization Problems
detail.abstract: Dichotomic search is a classical scalarization-based method for computing extreme supported nondominated points in bi-objective optimization. Its extension to more than two objectives and to continuous, numerically difficult problems is challenging due to the loss of a natural ordering of extreme supported points, the complexity of convex-hull updates, and the instability of weighted-sum solves.In this paper, we study dichotomic-search-based methods for complex multiobjective optimization problems. We review the bi-objective setting and higher-dimensional boundary dichotomic search, and propose a Continuous Boundary Dichotomic Search (CBDS) framework for continuous problems with approximate scalarization solves. The method combines boundary-first exploration, adaptive refinement of bi-objective subproblems, validity checks for dominated or inconsistent outcomes, and focused search on relevant regions of the weight set. We also introduce a Pareto knee score to identify extreme supported points with favorable trade-offs.Numerical experiments on multiobjective combinatorial problems, a radiotherapy beam intensity optimization problem, and a physics-informed neural network for a pendulum system illustrate the proposed framework. The results show that dichotomic-search-based methods can reliably identify extreme supported solutions with high Pareto knee scores with relatively few scalarization solves in low-dimensional settings, while also revealing the geometrical and computational limitations caused by the growth of convex-hull complexity in higher dimensions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种连续边界二分搜索（CBDS）框架，用于处理复杂多目标优化问题中的极端支撑非占优点计算，通过边界优先探索、自适应细化双目标子问题、有效性检查及帕累托膝点得分等方法，在低维场景下能以较少的标量化求解次数可靠识别高帕累托膝点得分的极端支撑解，同时揭示了高维情况下凸包复杂度增长带来的几何与计算局限性。
AI.research_question: 如何将二分搜索方法从双目标优化扩展到更复杂（多目标、连续、数值困难）的多目标优化问题，以有效计算极端支撑非占优点？
AI.motivation: 传统二分搜索法在扩展到两个以上目标以及连续、数值困难的优化问题时面临挑战，包括极端支撑点自然排序的缺失、凸包更新的复杂性增加以及加权和求解不稳定等问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 二分搜索法（Dichotomic search）、标量化方法（Scalarization）、凸包理论（Convex hull）、帕累托最优理论（Pareto optimality）
AI.method: 提出连续边界二分搜索（CBDS）框架，结合边界优先探索、双目标子问题的自适应细化、占优或不一致结果的有效性检查、以及对权重集相关区域的聚焦搜索；引入帕累托膝点得分以识别具有有利权衡的极端支撑点。
AI.findings: 在低维设定下，基于二分搜索的方法能以较少的标量化求解次数可靠识别具有高帕累托膝点得分的极端支撑解；同时揭示了高维空间中凸包复杂度增长导致的几何和计算局限性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了CBDS框架，将二分搜索方法系统性地推广到连续、多目标、数值困难的优化问题，弥补了传统方法在高维和近似求解场景下的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为多目标组合优化、放射治疗束强度优化、物理信息神经网络等实际问题提供了一种高效识别极端支撑解的方法，有助于在实际应用中找到权衡良好的帕累托最优解。

title: Option-Implied Tail Asymmetry and Bank Mortgage Pricing during Monetary Tightening

detail.title: Option-Implied Tail Asymmetry and Bank Mortgage Pricing during Monetary Tightening
detail.abstract: Do equity option markets contain information about how banks price household credit? Using loan-level HMDA mortgage data for 2018–2025 matched to bank equity-option surfaces, I construct a measure of option-implied tail asymmetry — 25-delta put–call skew orthogonalized to at-the-money volatility. Among non-money-center listed banks, lenders with higher pre-period tail asymmetry charge higher conforming-mortgage rates during the 2022–2024 tightening, by about 20–23 basis points per standard deviation — roughly $330 in additional first-year interest per affected borrower. The effect is absent before tightening and fades as rates stabilize, so I read it as informational rather than causal. It concentrates on the loans lenders retain and is negligible on the loans they sell, locating the premium on retained exposure. The same signal predicts five-year CDS widening in an international bank panel, corroborating that it captures bank fragility. The contribution is the loan-level household-credit pricing link, not the signal.

AI.tldr: 利用2018–2025年HMDA贷款数据匹配银行期权曲面，发现非货币中心银行在2022–2024年紧缩期前较高的期权尾部不对称程度，显著预测了其保留贷款中合规抵押贷款利率上升约20–23个基点，且该效应在紧缩期结束后消失，支持信息效应而非因果效应。
AI.research_question: 股权期权市场是否包含银行如何对家庭信贷定价的信息？具体而言，期权隐含的尾部风险能否预测银行在货币紧缩期间对抵押贷款的定价行为？
AI.motivation: 尽管已有大量文献研究期权市场对公司债券和股票价格的预测能力，但期权市场信息是否延伸至银行对家庭信贷（尤其是抵押贷款）的定价，尚缺乏直接证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 期权隐含尾部不对称（25-delta看跌-看涨偏斜，经平值波动率正交化）测度银行感知的尾部风险；银行在紧缩期通过提高保留贷款（而非出售贷款）的利率来对冲自身脆弱性。
AI.method: 将2018–2025年HMDA贷款层面抵押贷款数据与银行股权期权曲面匹配；构建期权隐含尾部不对称指标；在货币紧缩期（2022–2024）进行贷款层面回归分析，区分保留贷款与出售贷款；并用五年期CDS利差进行跨国银行面板验证。
AI.findings: 1) 紧缩期前尾部不对称每增加一个标准差，合规抵押贷款利率上升约20–23个基点（约330美元首年利息）；2) 该效应在紧缩前不存在，紧缩结束后消退，表明是信息效应而非因果效应；3) 效应集中于银行保留的贷款，对出售的贷款影响可忽略；4) 同一信号预测跨国银行五年期CDS利差扩大，验证其捕捉银行脆弱性。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在贷款层面建立期权市场尾部风险信号与家庭信贷定价之间的直接联系；将期权市场信息含量从公司金融拓展至零售银行信贷定价领域。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供基于市场的前瞻性银行脆弱性指标；帮助理解货币紧缩期银行信贷定价行为，揭示银行通过保留贷款定价转移风险的渠道。

title: KGER-PP: Knowledge Graph-Enhanced Reasoning for Process Planning based on Large Language Models
affiliations: Chongqing University and

detail.title: KGER-PP: Knowledge Graph-Enhanced Reasoning for Process Planning based on Large Language Models
detail.abstract: As manufacturing systems become more complex and dynamic, process planning must adapt to address the increased complexity, uncertainty, and demand for real-time decision-making. Knowledge graph can be used to store and process multi-modal complex process knowledge and support large-scale, dynamic manufacturing environments in form of process knowledge graph (PKG). However, the complex characteristics of PKG schemas and structures remain significant challenges for their effective utilisation in real-world manufacturing scenarios. Therefore, we propose the Knowledge Graph-Enhanced Reasoning framework for Process Planning (KGER-PP), integrating PKG with Large Language Models (LLMs) to enhance process knowledge reasoning. Firstly, a process planning semantic parsing module is introduced to transform natural language questions related to process planning into executable structured representations. Secondly, a structural and semantic enhancement method (StSeEM) is designed to generate knowledge-rich rationales that bridge the interpretability gap in answer generation by integrating structured information at the initial embedding stage and exploiting semantic knowledge via the chain-of-thought reasoning capabilities of LLMs. Thirdly, a graph-guided tuning method is proposed to align explicit reasoning paths with textual representations with a multi-modal future fusion mechanism, mitigating LLMs' hallucination risks through enforced factuality constraints. Finally, experimental results show that the proposed KGER-PP framework achieves the best performance in knowledge-intensive reasoning rationale generation tasks and outperforms the current state-of-the-art methods in process knowledge reasoning research. The code of our work is available at https://github.com/WenWph/KGER-PP.git

AI.tldr: 提出了KGER-PP框架，将工艺知识图谱与大语言模型结合，通过语义解析、结构语义增强和图引导调优等方法，显著提升了工艺规划中的知识推理能力。
AI.research_question: 如何将工艺知识图谱与大语言模型有效集成，以提升复杂制造环境下工艺规划的知识推理能力？
AI.motivation: 制造系统日益复杂和动态，传统工艺规划方法难以应对复杂性、不确定性和实时决策需求；工艺知识图谱虽能存储多模态知识，但其模式和结构的复杂性阻碍了实际应用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 知识图谱增强推理框架、大语言模型链式思维推理、多模态融合机制
AI.method: 提出了KGER-PP框架，包含三个核心模块：(1)工艺规划语义解析模块，将自然语言问题转化为结构化表示；(2)结构语义增强方法(StSeEM)，融合结构化信息和语义知识生成丰富推理链；(3)图引导调优方法，对齐推理路径与文本表示，并采用多模态未来融合机制约束幻觉。
AI.findings: KGER-PP框架在知识密集型推理理由生成任务上取得了最佳性能，在工艺知识推理研究中优于当前最先进方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了知识图谱与大语言模型协同增强的推理框架，设计了结构语义增强方法和图引导调优机制，为工艺知识推理提供了新的理论范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为复杂制造环境下的工艺规划提供了可落地的智能决策方案，代码已开源，便于工业界应用和进一步研究。
